title.zh: 卷409 列傳一百九十六 塔齐布 毕金科 多隆阿 孙寿长 鲍超 宋国永 娄雲庆 谭胜达 唐仁廉 刘松山
title.en: Volume 409 Biographies 196: Ta Qi Bu, Bi Jinke, Duo Long A, Sun Shouzhang, Bao Chao, Song Guoyong, Lou Yunqing, Tan Shengda, Tang Renlian, Liu Songshan
title.raw: 卷409 列傳一百九十六 塔齐布 毕金科 多隆阿 孙寿长 鲍超 宋国永 娄雲庆 谭胜达 唐仁廉 刘松山

sentences.zh: 塔齊布，字智亭，陶佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Taqibu, style Zhiting, of the Tao Jia clan, a man of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu, whose style was Zhiting, belonged to the Tao Jia clan and came from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 由火器營鳥槍護軍擢三等侍衛。

translations.literal: From an arquebus guardsman in the Firearms Brigade he was promoted to third-class imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the rank of arquebus guardsman in the Firearms Brigade to third-class imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，揀發湖南，以都司用，署撫標左營守備。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign he was selected and sent to Hunan, employed as a colonel, and appointed acting garrison commander of the provincial army's Left Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng era he was selected for service in Hunan, given the rank of colonel, and posted as acting garrison commander of the provincial army's Left Battalion.

sentences.zh: 以長沙守城功擢游擊，署中軍參將。

translations.literal: For merit in defending Changsha he was promoted to battalion commander and appointed acting brigade deputy.
translations.idiomatic: His success in the defense of Changsha won him promotion to battalion commander and an acting appointment as brigade deputy.

sentences.zh: 侍郎曾國籓在籍治鄉兵，月調官兵會操。

translations.literal: Vice President Zeng Guofan, while at home organizing local militia, each month summoned regular troops for joint drill.
translations.idiomatic: While at home organizing local militia, Vice President Zeng Guofan called up regular troops each month for joint exercises.

sentences.zh: 每校閱，塔齊布從侍，國籓與語，奇之，試所轄兵，特精整。

translations.literal: At every inspection Taqibu attended him; Guofan spoke with him, found him remarkable, tested the troops under his command, and found them exceptionally well disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: At each inspection Taqibu stood in attendance; Zeng Guofan talked with him, took a liking to him, and on testing the men under his command found them unusually sharp and orderly.

sentences.zh: 為副將清德所忌，嗾提督鮑起豹將加摧辱。

translations.literal: He was envied by Brigadier General Qing De, who incited Provincial Commander Bao Qibao to heap further humiliation upon him.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier General Qing De took a dislike to him and urged Provincial Commander Bao Qibao to subject him to further abuse.

sentences.zh: 國籓劾罷清德，薦塔齊布「忠勇可大用，如將來出戰不力，甘與同罪」，加副將銜，兼領練軍。

translations.literal: Guofan impeached and removed Qing De, and recommended Taqibu: "Loyal and brave, fit for great employment; if he should fail in battle hereafter, I am willing to share his punishment," adding the rank of brigadier general and putting him in charge of the training corps as well.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan impeached Qing De and had him dismissed, then recommended Taqibu in these terms: "Loyal and brave, he is fit for high command; if he should ever fail in the field, I am willing to bear the same penalty." Taqibu was given the rank of brigadier general and placed in command of the training corps as well.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張亮基亦特薦之，以副將用。

translations.literal: Governor Zhang Liangji also specially recommended him, and he was employed as brigadier general.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Liangji likewise gave him a special recommendation, and he was appointed brigadier general.

sentences.zh: 三年，剿平茶陵、安化土匪，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the third year he suppressed bandits in Chaling and Anhua and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he put down the bandits of Chaling and Anhua and was awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 四年，率所部進剿粵匪，至湖北通城、崇陽，賊由岳州上犯，奉檄援寧鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he led his command in pursuit of the Cantonese rebels, reaching Tongcheng and Chongyang in Hubei; when the rebels advanced from Yuezhou, he received orders to relieve Ningxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he led his troops against the Cantonese rebels as far as Tongcheng and Chongyang in Hubei; when the rebels marched up from Yuezhou, he was ordered to relieve Ningxiang.

sentences.zh: 未至，湘潭亦陷，賊勢甚張，遂改援湘潭。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, Xiangtan also fell; the rebel strength was very great, so he changed course to relieve Xiangtan instead.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could get there, Xiangtan had already fallen and the rebels were in great force, so he turned instead to relieve Xiangtan.

sentences.zh: 長驅至高嶺，猝遇賊，塔齊布手持大旗陷陣，麾軍縱擊，斬其酋數人，逐北數里，至城下。

translations.literal: He drove rapidly to Gaoling, suddenly encountered the rebels, Taqibu bore the great banner into the fight, commanded the army to strike freely, beheaded several of their chiefs, pursued them north for several li, and reached the foot of the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed on to Gaoling, where he suddenly met the enemy. Taqibu charged into the fray carrying the great banner, ordered a full assault, cut down several rebel leaders, and drove them north for miles until he reached the city walls.

sentences.zh: 明日，賊大出，塔齊布伏兵山左右，賊近，砲殪百餘人，伏起夾擊，僵僕枕藉，燔城外賊柵皆盡。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels came out in force; Taqibu hid troops on both flanks of the hill; when the rebels drew near, cannon killed more than a hundred; the ambush rose and struck from both sides, corpses lay piled one upon another, and all the rebel stockades outside the city were burned to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels sallied in strength. Taqibu concealed troops on both sides of the hill; when the enemy came near, artillery killed more than a hundred men, then the ambush rose and struck from both flanks. Dead lay heaped together, and every rebel stockade outside the walls was burned.

sentences.zh: 水師會戰，焚賊舟，浮屍蔽江。

translations.literal: The naval force joined battle, burned the rebel boats, and floating corpses covered the river.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet joined the fight, burned the rebel vessels, and corpses so covered the water that the river seemed choked with the dead.

sentences.zh: 賊棄城走，六日而湘潭平。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; in six days Xiangtan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; within six days Xiangtan was recovered.

sentences.zh: 時曾國籓師挫於靖港，長沙震動，賴此一戰破賊，人心始定。

translations.literal: At that time Zeng Guofan's army had been defeated at Jinggang and Changsha was shaken; it was by this battle that the rebels were broken and popular feeling first settled.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan's army had just suffered defeat at Jinggang, and Changsha was in turmoil; this victory broke the rebels and at last steadied the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，加總兵銜，賜號喀屯巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he was given the rank of regional commander and granted the title Katun Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: On report of the victory he was promoted to regional commander and granted the honorific title Katun Batulu.

sentences.zh: 詔斥鮑起豹畏葸不出戰，罷之，即超擢塔齊佈署提督，尋實授。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Bao Qibao for timidity and failure to take the field, removed him from office, and at once promoted Taqibu to acting provincial commander, soon giving him the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict condemned Bao Qibao for cowardice and his refusal to fight, removed him from office, and immediately elevated Taqibu to acting provincial commander, with the substantive post following soon after.

sentences.zh: 初，所部辰勇與標兵私鬥有釁，鮑起豹頻齮齕之；

translations.literal: Earlier, his Chen braves and the provincial regulars had clashed in private brawls and nursed grievances; Bao Qibao had repeatedly slandered and undermined him;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier his Chen braves and the provincial regulars had fought in private affrays and nursed grudges, and Bao Qibao had repeatedly slandered and undermined him;

sentences.zh: 至是代其位，遍賞提標兵，示無修怨意，標兵大讙。

translations.literal: now that he had taken Bao's place, he rewarded the provincial troops throughout, showing that he bore no wish to settle old scores, and the regulars rejoiced greatly.
translations.idiomatic: when he took Bao's place he rewarded the provincial troops all around to show he bore no grudge, and the regulars were overjoyed.

sentences.zh: 眾見其由都司不三年立功驟膺專閫，莫不驚服，軍氣頓振。

translations.literal: All saw that from colonel, in less than three years of merit, he had suddenly received sole command of a province; none failed to marvel and submit, and army morale revived at once.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone saw that in less than three years he had risen from colonel to sole provincial command through sheer merit, and the whole army was struck with admiration; morale revived overnight.

sentences.zh: 賊自湘潭敗後，退走岳州，分黨陷常、澧。

translations.literal: After their defeat at Xiangtan the rebels retreated toward Yuezhou, while detachments seized Changde and Li.
translations.idiomatic: After their defeat at Xiangtan the rebels fell back toward Yuezhou, while other bands seized Changde and Li.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布馳抵新牆為援，進與羅澤南合軍，會水師攻岳州，七月，克其城。

translations.literal: Taqibu galloped to Xinqian as relief, advanced and united with Luo Zinan, joined the naval force in attacking Yuezhou, and in the seventh month captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu hurried to Xinqian in support, advanced to join Luo Zinan, combined with the river fleet to attack Yuezhou, and in the seventh month took the city.

sentences.zh: 賊退泊城陵磯，勢猶盛，水陸夾擊，屢挫之。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew and anchored at Chenglingji, where their strength was still great; land and water forces attacked from both sides and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew to Chenglingji, where they were still strong, but joint land and river attacks repeatedly broke them.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓親率新募水師至，戰失利。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan personally led the newly recruited naval force there, and the battle went against them.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan personally led the newly raised river fleet to the scene, but the engagement went badly.

sentences.zh: 越日，賊由城陵磯舍舟登陸踞險，三路來撲，塔齊布分路迎擊，匹馬陷陣，士卒皆猛進，破其中路，賊复包鈔；

translations.literal: The next day the rebels left their boats at Chenglingji, went ashore to hold the heights, and came pressing in on three routes; Taqibu met them on separate fronts, charged into the line alone on horseback, his soldiers all pressed forward fiercely, broke their center route, and the rebels again tried to envelop them;
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels abandoned their boats at Chenglingji, seized the high ground, and attacked on three fronts. Taqibu met them on each route, charged alone into the enemy line, and his men pressed forward so fiercely that they broke the center column; the rebels then tried to surround them;

sentences.zh: 愈戰愈奮，賊敗走，追至擂鼓臺，斬馘八百，落水者無數。

translations.literal: the harder they fought the fiercer they grew; the rebels were defeated and fled; pursuit reached Leigutai; eight hundred were beheaded and countless fell into the water.
translations.idiomatic: but the harder the fight grew, the fiercer Taqibu's men became. The rebels broke and fled; the pursuit reached Leigutai, where eight hundred were killed and countless more drowned.

sentences.zh: 迭偕羅澤南合力攻賊，旬日三捷。

translations.literal: Again and again he joined Luo Zinan in combined attacks on the rebels, and in ten days won three victories.
translations.idiomatic: He and Luo Zinan attacked the rebels together again and again, winning three victories in ten days.

sentences.zh: 水師乘隙進剿，賊勢始衰，岳州危而不失。

translations.literal: The naval force seized the opening to press the pursuit, the rebel strength began to wane, and Yuezhou, though in peril, was not lost.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet pressed the advantage, the rebel power began to fail, and Yuezhou, though hard pressed, held firm.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，偕羅澤南、李續賓進高橋，賊出二萬人抗拒。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month he advanced on Gaoqiao with Luo Zinan and Li Xubin; the rebels came out twenty thousand strong to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month he advanced on Gaoqiao with Luo Zinan and Li Xubin, where twenty thousand rebels came out to oppose them.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布首先沖入，諸軍繼之，會大雨，賊砲不燃；

translations.literal: Taqibu was first to charge in, the other armies followed, and by chance a great rain fell so that the rebel cannon would not fire;
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu led the charge, the other columns followed, and a heavy rain fell so that the rebel guns would not fire;

sentences.zh: 逾溝入壘，連破賊營十三座，殲斃及逃散者數千。

translations.literal: they crossed the ditch and entered the stockades, broke thirteen rebel camps in succession, and killed or scattered several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: they crossed the ditches, stormed the works, took thirteen rebel camps in succession, and killed or scattered several thousand men.

sentences.zh: 水師亦分路剿殺，賊遁走，追擊二百餘里，破之於羊樓峒，又破之於崇陽，克其城，咸寧亦復。

translations.literal: The naval force also divided routes to pursue and kill; the rebels fled; pursuit ran more than two hundred li; they were defeated at Yangloudong, defeated again at Chongyang and its city taken, and Xianning was also recovered.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet also hunted them on several routes. The rebels fled; the pursuit ran more than two hundred li, broke them at Yangloudong and again at Chongyang, where the city was taken, and Xianning was recovered as well.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓師抵金口，令羅澤南攻花園，塔齊布趨洪山。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan's army reached Jinkou; he ordered Luo Zinan to attack Huayuan and Taqibu to press toward Hongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan's army reached Jinkou. He ordered Luo Zinan to attack Huayuan and sent Taqibu toward Hongshan.

sentences.zh: 八月，武昌賊遁走，塔齊布預設伏，賊至，要擊，左右夾湖無去路，殲戮溺斃八九千人，武、漢同時克復。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the rebels of Wuchang fled; Taqibu had set an ambush beforehand; when the rebels arrived he intercepted them; on both sides the lake left no escape; eight or nine thousand were slaughtered or drowned, and Wuchang and Hankou were recovered at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Wuchang rebels fled. Taqibu had laid an ambush; when they came he cut them off between the lakes so that they had no escape, and eight or nine thousand were killed or drowned. Wuchang and Hankou were recovered together.

sentences.zh: 進攻大冶，克之。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Daye and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Daye and took it.

sentences.zh: 十月，與羅澤南會攻田家鎮，澤南攻半壁山，塔齊布屯富池口，中隔小河，作浮橋以通兩軍之路。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he joined Luo Zinan in attacking Tianjiazhen; Zinan attacked Banbishan while Taqibu encamped at Fuchikou; a small river lay between them, and he built a pontoon bridge to link the two armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he and Luo Zinan attacked Tianjiazhen together. Zinan assaulted Banbishan while Taqibu held Fuchikou; a stream lay between them, and he built a pontoon bridge to connect the two wings.

sentences.zh: 賊以萬人來爭，澤南率李續賓奮戰，塔齊布隔港對擊，浮橋成。

translations.literal: Ten thousand rebels came to contest the ground; Zinan led Li Xubin in fierce fighting while Taqibu struck from across the harbor, and the pontoon bridge was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand rebels came to dispute the position. Zinan and Li Xubin fought fiercely while Taqibu attacked from across the harbor, and the pontoon bridge was finished.

sentences.zh: 賊復由田家鎮渡江撲富池口營壘，迎擊敗之。

translations.literal: The rebels again crossed the river from Tianjiazhen to rush the camp at Fuchikou; he met them and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels crossed again from Tianjiazhen to storm the Fuchikou camp, but he met them and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 遂與水師約大舉，楊岳斌、彭玉麟分隊毀其橫江鐵鎖，陸師從半壁山擁下，鏖戰一晝夜，鐵鎖盡毀，賊舟盡焚。

translations.literal: He then agreed with the naval force on a general assault; Yang Yuebin and Peng Yulin in separate squadrons destroyed the iron chains across the river; the land army poured down from Banbishan; they fought fiercely for a day and a night; the chains were all destroyed and the rebel boats all burned.
translations.idiomatic: He then coordinated a major assault with the river fleet. Yang Yuebin and Peng Yulin broke the iron chains across the Yangzi in separate squadrons while the land force swept down from Banbishan. After a day and night of fierce fighting the chains were destroyed and every rebel vessel burned.

sentences.zh: 賊棄壘而遁，克田家鎮，蘄州亦復，賜黃馬褂，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned their stockades and fled; Tianjiazhen was taken and Qizhou also recovered; he was granted the yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned their works and fled. Tianjiazhen was taken and Qizhou recovered. He was granted the yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 偕羅澤南渡江至蓮花橋，遇伏，前隊少卻，塔齊布手刃賊目，追奔五十里，遂克廣濟。

translations.literal: He crossed the river with Luo Zinan to Lianhuaqiao, met an ambush, and the vanguard fell back slightly; Taqibu himself killed a rebel officer, pursued the flight fifty li, and then took Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the river with Luo Zinan to Lianhuaqiao, where an ambush made the vanguard fall back. Taqibu himself cut down a rebel officer, pursued the enemy fifty li, and took Guangji.

sentences.zh: 悍酋秦日綱、陳玉成、羅大綱效力守黃梅，以數万賊布小池口、孔壟驛，而大河埔、龍頭寨皆立堅壘。

translations.literal: The fierce chiefs Qin Rigang, Chen Yucheng, and Luo Dagang strove to hold Huangmei; tens of thousands of rebels were posted at Xiaochikou and Konglong Post, while Dahepu and Longtousai both had strong stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce rebel leaders Qin Rigang, Chen Yucheng, and Luo Dagang defended Huangmei with all their strength. Tens of thousands of rebels held Xiaochikou and Konglong Post, and strong works stood at Dahepu and Longtousai.

sentences.zh: 軍抵雙城驛，賊突來襲，堅持不動，旋突起憑高下擊，斬其渠。

translations.literal: When the army reached Shuangcheng Post the rebels suddenly attacked; he held firm without moving, then suddenly rose and struck down from the heights, beheading their leader.
translations.idiomatic: At Shuangcheng Post the rebels suddenly attacked, but he held his ground. Then he sprang up, struck from the high ground, and beheaded their leader.

sentences.zh: 賊奔大河埔，糾黨返鬥，連擊敗之，殪三千餘，進攻黃梅，肉薄而登。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Dahepu, gathered their bands, and returned to fight; he defeated them again and again, killed more than three thousand, advanced on Huangmei, and stormed the walls hand to hand.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Dahepu, rallied, and came back to fight, but he defeated them repeatedly, killing more than three thousand, then advanced on Huangmei and scaled the walls in close assault.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布被石擊，流血被面，督戰益力，克其城。

translations.literal: Taqibu was struck by a stone, blood covered his face, yet he directed the battle with greater force and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: A stone struck Taqibu and blood covered his face, yet he pressed the attack all the harder and took the city.

sentences.zh: 賊麕聚孔壟驛，三面築土城，塔齊布從西南進，累肩為梯，卓矛而躍，大破之。

translations.literal: The rebels crowded together at Konglong Post and built earthen walls on three sides; Taqibu advanced from the southwest, piled shoulders to make ladders, leaped with spears raised high, and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels massed at Konglong Post and built earthen walls on three sides. Taqibu attacked from the southwest, men climbing on one another's shoulders as ladders, leaping in with spears held high, and broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 賊悉竄小池口，分黨奔湖口，與九江之賊相犄角。

translations.literal: The rebels all fled into Xiaochikou; detachments ran to Hukou and formed a pincer with the rebels at Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels all fled to Xiaochikou while other bands ran to Hukou and linked up with the Jiujiang garrison in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓率水師抵九江，塔齊布偕羅澤南渡江會攻。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan led the naval force to Jiujiang; Taqibu crossed the river with Luo Zinan to join the assault.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan brought the river fleet to Jiujiang, and Taqibu crossed with Luo Zinan to join the attack.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉諸將轉戰直前，同心效力，特頒珍賚。

translations.literal: An edict praised the generals for advancing straight through successive campaigns and serving with one heart, and specially bestowed precious gifts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised the generals for fighting their way forward campaign after campaign and serving with one heart, and granted them special rewards.

sentences.zh: 十二月，攻九江西南門不克，驍將童添元死之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month they attacked the southwest gate of Jiujiang without success, and the fierce general Tong Tianyuan died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month they assaulted the southwest gate of Jiujiang without success, and the fierce general Tong Tianyuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 會水師為賊所襲，喪失輜重。

translations.literal: Just then the naval force was attacked by the rebels and lost its baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: About that time the river fleet was ambushed by the rebels and lost its supplies.

sentences.zh: 羅澤南攻小池口，塔齊布親率勇士二十人往督戰，眾寡不敵，且戰且退，匹馬衝突，為諸營扞蔽。

translations.literal: Luo Zinan attacked Xiaochikou; Taqibu personally led twenty brave men to supervise the battle; they were outnumbered, fought while retreating, charged alone on horseback through the enemy, and shielded the various camps.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Zinan attacked Xiaochikou. Taqibu personally led twenty picked men to direct the fight. Outnumbered, they fought as they fell back; he charged alone through the enemy ranks and shielded the other camps.

sentences.zh: 有黃衣賊酋三來犯，塔齊布以套馬竿圈一酋斬之，奪其馬，餘賊皆靡，俟大隊沿江上，始單騎渡江回營，已除夕三鼓。

translations.literal: Three rebel chiefs in yellow came to attack; Taqibu with a lasso pole looped one chief, beheaded him, seized his horse; the rest of the rebels all wavered; he waited until the main body came up along the river, then crossed the river alone on horseback back to camp—it was already the third watch of New Year's Eve.
translations.idiomatic: Three rebel chiefs in yellow came at him. Taqibu snared one with his lasso pole, cut him down, and took his horse; the rest broke. He waited for the main column to come up along the river, then rode back alone across the Yangzi to camp—it was already deep in New Year's Eve night.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，城賊出犯，斬獲二百餘，又伏地雷誘賊來撲，斃之，戰屢捷而城不下。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year the city rebels came out to attack; more than two hundred were beheaded or captured; he also laid land mines to lure the rebels into a rush and killed them; battles were often won yet the city would not fall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year the garrison sallied forth; he killed or captured more than two hundred, laid land mines to lure the enemy into a charge and destroyed them, and won repeated victories, yet the city still would not fall.

sentences.zh: 三月，總督楊霈師潰，武昌复陷，塔齊布分兵遣將回援。

translations.literal: In the third month Governor-General Yang Yizhen's army was routed, Wuchang fell again, and Taqibu divided his forces and sent generals back to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Governor-General Yang Yizhen's army was routed and Wuchang fell again. Taqibu detached troops and sent generals back to its relief.

sentences.zh: 時水師半頓鄱陽湖，半回湖北，陸師留攻九江，力甚單，賊益堅拒。

translations.literal: At that time half the naval force lay at Poyang Lake and half had returned to Hubei; the land army remained to besiege Jiujiang with very thin strength, and the rebels resisted all the more stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: Half the river fleet was held at Poyang Lake and half had returned to Hubei, while the land force that remained before Jiujiang was dangerously weak, and the rebels defended all the more stubbornly.

sentences.zh: 六月，與曾國籓會於青山議軍事，國籓謂宜移師東渡，剿湖口、東流、建德，塔齊布誓攻九江。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he met Zeng Guofan at Qingshan to discuss military affairs; Guofan said the army ought to shift east across the river to suppress Hukou, Dongliu, and Jiande, but Taqibu swore to attack Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he met Zeng Guofan at Qingshan to discuss strategy. Zeng Guofan urged shifting east across the river to clear Hukou, Dongliu, and Jiande, but Taqibu vowed to take Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 七月，方傳令薄城，遽氣脫卒於軍，年三十有九。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, just as orders were issued to press close to the walls, he suddenly expired in camp at the age of thirty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, just as orders went out to press the assault on the walls, he died suddenly in camp at the age of thirty-nine.

sentences.zh: 事聞，文宗震悼，詔依將軍例賜卹，湖南省城建專祠，諡忠武。

translations.literal: When word reached the throne, the Wenzong Emperor was deeply shaken and grieved; an edict granted condolence payments according to the precedent for a general, ordered a special temple built in Hunan Province, and gave the posthumous title Zhongwu (Loyal and Martial).
translations.idiomatic: When the news reached court, the Wenzong Emperor was stricken with grief. An edict granted funeral honors according to the precedent for a general, ordered a special temple built in Hunan, and gave him the posthumous title Zhongwu, Loyal and Martial.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，江南平，加三等輕車都尉世職，入祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, when Jiangnan was pacified, he was given the third-class hereditary office of Commandant of Light Chariots and entered worship in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi, when Jiangnan was pacified, he was granted a third-class hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots and enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布忠勇絕倫，自擢提督，涅「忠心報國」四字於左臂。

translations.literal: Taqibu's loyalty and bravery were unmatched; from the time he was promoted provincial commander he had the four characters "Loyal heart repays the state" tattooed on his left arm.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu's loyalty and courage were unmatched. From the day he became provincial commander he had the words "A loyal heart repays the state" tattooed on his left arm.

sentences.zh: 每戰，匹馬當先，不使士卒出己前。

translations.literal: In every battle he rode alone in the van and would not let his soldiers go ahead of him.
translations.idiomatic: In every battle he charged alone at the head of the line and never let his men go before him.

sentences.zh: 他軍被圍輒馳救。

translations.literal: Whenever another army was surrounded he galloped to its rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever another unit was surrounded, he rode to its relief.

sentences.zh: 背負槍，挾弓矢，二卒持長矛、套馬竿從，皆精絕，無虛發。

translations.literal: He carried a musket on his back and bow and arrows at his side; two soldiers followed with long spears and lasso poles; all were supremely skilled, and none shot in vain.
translations.idiomatic: He carried a musket on his back and bow and arrows at his side, with two soldiers behind him bearing long spears and lasso poles. All were masters of their arms, and none ever missed.

sentences.zh: 每逼賊壘覘形勢，瀕危輒免，賊驚為神，而從容謙退，未嘗自伐其能。

translations.literal: Each time he pressed close to rebel stockades to reconnoiter the situation he escaped when on the brink of peril; the rebels marveled that he was divine, yet he was calm and modest in retreat and never boasted of his ability.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he rode up to inspect a rebel stockade he escaped danger as if by miracle, and the enemy took him for something more than human; yet he remained calm and modest and never boasted of his prowess.

sentences.zh: 在岳州，率四騎覘擂鼓臺，忽有悍酋獰髯睅目，持槊來犯。

translations.literal: At Yuezhou he led four horsemen to reconnoiter Leigutai; suddenly a fierce chief with bristling beard and bulging eyes came attacking with a spear.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuezhou he rode out with four men to scout Leigutai when a fierce rebel chief with bristling beard and glaring eyes charged at him with a spear.

sentences.zh: 健卒黃明魁矛刺酋墜馬，塔齊布手刃殪之，獲其旗，知為偽丞相曾天養，驍桀稱最，群賊奪氣，尋皆引去。

translations.literal: The stalwart soldier Huang Mingkui speared the chief and knocked him from his horse; Taqibu himself killed him with a blade, seized his banner, and learned that he was the false chancellor Zeng Tianyang, fiercest of the fierce; the rebel host lost its spirit and soon all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: His stalwart Huang Mingkui speared the chief and knocked him from his horse; Taqibu finished him with his own blade and seized his banner. It was the false chancellor Zeng Tianyang, the rebels' fiercest fighter. The whole enemy host lost heart and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 先是水師毀天養坐船，已報殲斃。

translations.literal: Earlier the naval force had destroyed Zeng Tianyang's boat and already reported him killed.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet had already destroyed Zeng Tianyang's boat and reported him killed.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布不欲爭功，終不上聞。

translations.literal: Taqibu did not wish to contend for credit and in the end never reported it upward.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu would not claim the credit and never reported the matter to his superiors.

sentences.zh: 軍中與下卒同甘苦，嘗共中夜絮語家事，念及老母，泣下。

translations.literal: In the army he shared hardship and comfort with the lowest soldiers, and once at midnight talked of family affairs with them; thinking of his aged mother, he wept.
translations.idiomatic: In camp he shared the hardships of the lowest ranks and once talked of home with common soldiers far into the night; when he thought of his old mother, he wept.

sentences.zh: 其卒也，軍民皆慟。

translations.literal: At his death soldiers and civilians alike grieved.
translations.idiomatic: At his death soldiers and civilians alike mourned him.

sentences.zh: 湘潭、岳州兩捷，關係湘軍大局。

translations.literal: The two victories at Xiangtan and Yuezhou bore on the overall situation of the Hunan army.
translations.idiomatic: The victories at Xiangtan and Yuezhou were decisive for the Hunan army's fortunes as a whole.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓尤痛惜焉。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan grieved for him above all.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan mourned him above all others.

sentences.zh: 畢金科，字應侯，雲南臨沅人。

translations.literal: Bi Jinke, style Yinghou, a native of Linyuan in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Bi Jinke, whose style was Yinghou, was a native of Linyuan in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 以徵開化苗功，敘外委。

translations.literal: For merit in campaigning against the Kaihua Miao he was recorded as an acting platoon officer.
translations.idiomatic: For his service in the campaign against the Kaihua Miao he was given the rank of acting platoon officer.

sentences.zh: 從王國才赴湖北，破賊荊州龍會橋、天門丁司橋，累擢都司。

translations.literal: He followed Wang Guocai to Hubei, defeated rebels at Longhuiqiao in Jingzhou and Dingsiqiao in Tianmen, and was repeatedly promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Wang Guocai to Hubei, defeated the rebels at Longhuiqiao in Jingzhou and at Dingsiqiao in Tianmen, and was promoted repeatedly until he reached the rank of colonel.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奇其才，令從攻九江，改隸塔齊布部下。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan admired his talent, ordered him to follow the attack on Jiujiang, and transferred him to serve under Taqibu.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan admired his talent, assigned him to the Jiujiang campaign, and transferred him to Taqibu's command.

sentences.zh: 及塔齊布歿，石達開擾江西。

translations.literal: When Taqibu died, Shi Dakai harried Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: After Taqibu's death, Shi Dakai ravaged Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 金科每戰陷陣，驍勇為諸軍冠。

translations.literal: Jinke in every battle charged into the enemy line; his fierce bravery was foremost in all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In every battle Jinke led the charge, and his courage was unmatched in the army.

sentences.zh: 五年冬，破賊樟樹鎮，而周鳳山軍敗，尋失之。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fifth year he defeated the rebels at Zhangshuzhen, but Zhou Fengshan's army was beaten and the place was soon lost again.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year he defeated the rebels at Zhangshuzhen, but Zhou Fengshan's army was routed and the town was soon lost again.

sentences.zh: 六年，破賊章田渡，未幾，饒州陷，又失之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he defeated the rebels at Zhangtiandu; before long Raozhou fell and he lost it again.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he defeated the rebels at Zhangtiandu, but Raozhou soon fell and was lost again.

sentences.zh: 金科憤為他部所累，募死士攻取饒州。

translations.literal: Jinke, angry at being dragged down by other units, recruited dare-to-die men to storm Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Angry that other units had undone his work, Jinke recruited dare-to-die men to retake Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 誓曰：「今日上岸不破賊，吾不復歸舟！」

translations.literal: He swore: "If today on shore I do not break the rebels, I shall not return to my boat!"
translations.idiomatic: He swore: "If I do not break the enemy today on shore, I will not return to my boat!"

sentences.zh: 一鼓克其城，賜號呼爾察巴圖魯，補臨沅鎮都司，以游擊升用。

translations.literal: With one drum-roll he took the city, was granted the title Hurcha Batulu, given the substantive post of colonel at Linyuan garrison, and promoted for use as battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the first assault he took the city. He was granted the title Hurcha Batulu, given a substantive colonel's post at Linyuan, and promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 名大振而忌者眾，軍食不繼，金科鬱鬱，思立奇功。

translations.literal: His fame rose greatly but those who envied him were many; army provisions did not keep up; Jinke grew depressed and thought to win a singular exploit.
translations.idiomatic: His fame spread, but so did envy; supplies failed to keep up, and Jinke grew restless, determined to win a spectacular victory.

sentences.zh: 江西大吏責其破景德鎮始給餉。

translations.literal: The high officials of Jiangxi said they would supply rations only if he took Jingdezhen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangxi authorities refused supplies until he took Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，驟往攻之，入市不見一人，率十卒搜捕，賊蜂起，傷其七，亡其三，隻身縱橫擊刺，踐血而出。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year he suddenly went to attack it, entered the market and saw not a soul, led ten soldiers to search and seize; rebels swarmed up; seven of his men were wounded and three lost; he alone fought back and forth with thrust and cut, trampling blood as he came out.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year he rushed to attack it, entered the market and found it empty, and led ten men to search the town. Rebels rose on every side; seven of his men were wounded and three killed. He fought alone through the streets and came out treading blood.

sentences.zh: 賊以噴筒環攻於王家洲，殞焉。

translations.literal: The rebels surrounded him at Wangjiazhou with fire lances and he perished there.
translations.idiomatic: At Wangjiazhou the rebels surrounded him with fire lances and killed him.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓為勒碑紀事，稱其勇與塔齊布相埒。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan had a stele carved to record the affair and said his courage matched Taqibu's.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan had a stele erected in his memory and declared his courage equal to Taqibu's.

sentences.zh: 洎江南平，疏請優恤，贈總兵銜，諡剛毅，立祠景德鎮。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan was pacified he memorialized requesting generous condolence, granted the posthumous rank of regional commander, gave the posthumous title Gangyi (Resolute and Firm), and ordered a temple built at Jingdezhen.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan was pacified he memorialized for generous honors: Jinke was given the posthumous rank of regional commander, the title Gangyi, Resolute and Firm, and a temple at Jingdezhen.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿，字禮堂，呼爾拉特氏，滿洲正白旗人，黑龍江駐防。

translations.literal: Dolong'a, style Litang, of the Hurlat clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, garrisoned in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a, whose style was Litang, belonged to the Hurlat clan, came from the Manchu Plain White Banner, and was garrisoned in Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 由前鋒補驍騎校。

translations.literal: From the vanguard he was appointed acting captain of the Vanguard Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as a vanguard and was appointed acting captain of the Vanguard Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，從勝保剿粵匪，解懷慶圍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he followed Sengge Rinchen in suppressing the Cantonese rebels and relieved the siege of Huaiqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he followed Sengge Rinchen against the Cantonese rebels and helped lift the siege of Huaiqing.

sentences.zh: 及賊擾畿輔，僧格林沁督師，徵兵黑龍江，多隆阿率二起馬隊從克連鎮、馮官屯，擢佐領。

translations.literal: When the rebels troubled the capital region, Sengge Rinchen took command; troops were levied from Heilongjiang; Dolong'a led the second contingent of horse troops in the capture of Lianzhen and Fengguantun and was promoted to assistant banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels threatened the capital region, Sengge Rinchen took command and levied troops from Heilongjiang. Dolong'a led the second horse contingent in the capture of Lianzhen and Fengguantun and was promoted to assistant banner commander.

sentences.zh: 五年，調援湖北，隸將軍都興阿部下。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to relieve Hubei and placed under General Doxingga.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Hubei and placed under General Doxingga.

sentences.zh: 破賊黃州、新洲，從克廣濟。

translations.literal: He defeated rebels at Huangzhou and Xinzhou and took part in capturing Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the rebels at Huangzhou and Xinzhou and took part in the capture of Guangji.

sentences.zh: 六年，克武昌、漢陽，加副都統銜，補協領，充行營翼長。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he helped take Wuchang and Hankou, was given the rank of vice banner commander, received the substantive post of co-commander, and served as wing commander of the field camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he helped take Wuchang and Hankou, was given the rank of vice banner commander, appointed co-commander of the banner, and made wing commander of the field army.

sentences.zh: 進剿蘄州，敗賊於曹家河，复廣濟，次孔壟；

translations.literal: Advancing to suppress Qizhou, he defeated the rebels at Caojiahe, recovered Guangji, and then moved to Konglong;
translations.idiomatic: Advancing against Qizhou, he defeated the rebels at Caojiahe, recovered Guangji, and then moved on Konglong;

sentences.zh: 賊復來犯廣濟，擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels again came to attack Guangji; he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels attacked Guangji again, and he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 時湘軍圍攻九江，賊於對岸小池口築土城，環以堅壘，附近數十里內，段窯、楓樹坳、獨山鎮等處賊壘凡數十。

translations.literal: At the time the Hunan army was besieging Jiujiang; the rebels built an earthen wall at Xiaochikou on the opposite bank, surrounded by strong fortifications; within several tens of li nearby, rebel stockades at Duanyao, Fengshu'ao, Dushanzhen, and other places numbered several dozen.
translations.idiomatic: While the Hunan army besieged Jiujiang, the rebels built an earthen fort at Xiaochikou on the opposite bank, ringed with strong works. Within several tens of li nearby, they held several dozen stockades at places such as Duanyao, Fengshu'ao, and Dushanzhen.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，都興阿與鮑超攻小池口，令多隆阿趨段窯，甫至，賊數千來拒，一戰破之，毀其壘。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, Doxingga and Bao Chao attacked Xiaochikou and ordered Dolong'a to advance on Duanyao; he had just arrived when several thousand rebels came to resist; one battle broke them and destroyed their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year, Doxingga and Bao Chao attacked Xiaochikou and sent Dolong'a toward Duanyao. He had barely arrived when several thousand rebels came out to resist; one battle broke them and destroyed their stockade.

sentences.zh: 揚言攻獨山鎮，而暗襲楓樹坳，賊三路分拒，分擊之。

translations.literal: He proclaimed an attack on Dushanzhen but secretly struck Fengshu'ao; the rebels divided into three routes to resist, and he divided his forces and struck them.
translations.idiomatic: He announced an attack on Dushanzhen but struck Fengshu'ao in secret. The rebels split into three lines of resistance, and he divided his own forces to attack them.

sentences.zh: 別遣隊繞山南襲賊營，賊陣亂紛竄，進殪三千餘，乘勝疾趨獨山鎮。

translations.literal: He separately dispatched a unit to circle south of the mountain and strike the rebel camp; the rebel ranks broke in disorder and fled; advancing, he killed more than three thousand and, riding the victory, hurried toward Dushanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: He sent another detachment around the south of the mountain to strike the rebel camp. The rebel ranks broke and fled in disorder; pressing forward, he killed more than three thousand and, riding the victory, rushed on Dushanzhen.

sentences.zh: 四鼓至，月明如晝，見賊壘浚深壕，木椿竹籤環之，不易攻。

translations.literal: Arriving at the fourth watch, the moonlight was bright as day; he saw the rebel stockade with deep moats dug and wooden stakes and bamboo spikes surrounding it—not easy to assault.
translations.idiomatic: They arrived at the fourth watch. The moon was bright as day, and they found the rebel stockade ringed by deep trenches, wooden stakes, and bamboo spikes—not an easy place to assault.

sentences.zh: 以輕騎誘賊出，散隊設伏，伺賊至，以勁騎衝突，又分隊潛越壕縱火，賊大奔，追殺至曉，斃賊五千，生擒數百。

translations.literal: With light cavalry he lured the rebels out, dispersed his units and set ambushes, and when the rebels arrived charged with elite horsemen; he also sent a detachment secretly across the moat to set fires; the rebels fled in great disorder; pursuit and slaughter continued until dawn, killing five thousand rebels and capturing several hundred alive.
translations.idiomatic: He used light cavalry to draw the rebels out, spread his men in ambush, and when they came charged with his best horsemen. Another detachment slipped across the moat and set fires. The rebels broke and fled; the pursuit lasted until dawn, leaving five thousand dead and several hundred taken alive.

sentences.zh: 自是賊畏其軍，見旗輒走。

translations.literal: From then on the rebels feared his army; at sight of its banner they fled.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the rebels feared his army and fled at the sight of its banners.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成率悍黨踞黃梅，連營百里，官軍屢挫。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng led fierce partisans to hold Huangmei, encamped in a continuous line a hundred li long, and the government forces suffered repeated defeats.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng led his fiercest fighters to hold Huangmei in camps stretching a hundred li, and the government forces suffered defeat after defeat.

sentences.zh: 六月，多隆阿偕鮑超赴援，戰於黃梅十里鋪，分兵潛攻西路億生寺賊壘，賊出不意，駭奔，而十里鋪之賊亦大敗；

translations.literal: In the sixth month Dolong'a went with Bao Chao to the relief; they fought at Shilipu in Huangmei, divided troops to secretly attack the rebel stockade at Yisheng Temple on the western route; caught unawares, the rebels fled in terror, and the rebels at Shilipu were also utterly defeated;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Dolong'a went with Bao Chao to the relief. They fought at Shilipu in Huangmei and sent a detachment to strike secretly at the rebel stockade at Yisheng Temple on the western route. Taken by surprise, the rebels fled in panic, and the force at Shilipu was routed as well;

sentences.zh: 水師進毀童司牌賊壘，湘軍自九江來援，合擊，大破賊於黃蠟山，平賊壘凡百餘，逐北至宿松城下，遂克黃梅，以副都統記名。

translations.literal: The naval force advanced and destroyed the rebel stockade at Tongsipai; the Hunan army came from Jiujiang to reinforce; together they struck and utterly defeated the rebels at Huanglashan, levelled more than a hundred rebel stockades, pursued north to the walls of Susong, and then took Huangmei; he was recorded for appointment as vice banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: The river fleet advanced and destroyed the rebel stockade at Tongsipai. Reinforcements came from Jiujiang, and together they routed the rebels at Huanglashan, levelled more than a hundred stockades, and pursued north to the walls of Susong before taking Huangmei. Dolong'a was recorded for appointment as vice banner commander.

sentences.zh: 賊尋棄宿鬆而去，多隆阿率馬隊駐守。

translations.literal: The rebels soon abandoned Susong and withdrew; Dolong'a led the cavalry to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels soon abandoned Susong and withdrew, and Dolong'a led his cavalry to garrison the city.

sentences.zh: 鮑超以步隊屯二郎河。

translations.literal: Bao Chao stationed his infantry at Er'langhe.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao posted his infantry at Er'langhe.

sentences.zh: 九月，賊陷太湖，分路來犯，偕鮑超合擊於涼亭河，破之；

translations.literal: In the ninth month the rebels took Taihu and came attacking by divided routes; together with Bao Chao he combined forces at Liangtinghe and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the rebels took Taihu and attacked along several routes. Together with Bao Chao he combined forces at Liangtinghe and defeated them;

sentences.zh: 又合擊於楓香驛，賊死抗，鏖戰逾時，盡破其壘，乃遁太湖。

translations.literal: Again they combined at Fengxiang Post; the rebels resisted to the death; after fierce fighting lasting hours, all their stockades were destroyed, and they fled toward Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: They joined forces again at Fengxiang Post. The rebels fought to the death in a battle that raged for hours until every stockade was broken, and they fled back toward Taihu.

sentences.zh: 八年春，賊由渡船口等處上犯，將綴官軍，以緩九江之攻。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year the rebels advanced from Ducchuankou and other points, intending to detain the government forces and slow the attack on Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year the rebels advanced from Ducchuankou and other points, hoping to tie down the government forces and relieve the pressure on Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿伺其初至，急擊走之。

translations.literal: Dolong'a waited until they had just arrived and swiftly struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a waited until they had barely arrived and struck swiftly, driving them off.

sentences.zh: 四月，九江克復，多隆阿從都興阿進規安慶，石牌為要衝，賊據山阻水為堅壘，水陸重兵守之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Jiujiang was recovered; Dolong'a followed Doxingga in advancing against Anqing; Shipai was the key crossing; the rebels held mountains and blocked the water with strong fortifications, guarded by heavy forces on land and water.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Jiujiang was recovered. Dolong'a followed Doxingga in advancing against Anqing. Shipai was the vital crossing, and the rebels had built strong works on the hills and across the water, defended by heavy forces on both land and river.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿攻上石牌，鮑超攻下石牌，同時並下。

translations.literal: Dolong'a attacked Upper Shipai and Bao Chao attacked Lower Shipai; both were taken at once.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a attacked Upper Shipai while Bao Chao attacked Lower Shipai, and both positions fell at the same time.

sentences.zh: 餘壘驚竄，馬步截殺及落水溺斃者六千餘人，其酋以數十騎逃入安慶；

translations.literal: The remaining stockades fled in panic; cavalry and infantry cut them down and drowned more than six thousand; their chiefs escaped into Anqing with several dozen horsemen;
translations.idiomatic: The remaining stockades broke and fled. Cavalry and infantry cut them down or drowned more than six thousand, while their chiefs escaped into Anqing with a few dozen horsemen;

sentences.zh: 遂進軍逼安慶，破城外九壘，城賊屢出戰，皆擊敗之。

translations.literal: He then advanced and pressed Anqing, broke nine stockades outside the walls, and whenever the city rebels came out to fight, he defeated them all.
translations.idiomatic: He then pressed on toward Anqing, took nine stockades outside the walls, and defeated every sortie the city rebels mounted.

sentences.zh: 會李續賓戰歿三河，桐、舒、潛、太諸縣皆不守。

translations.literal: Just then Li Xubin was killed in battle at Sanhe; Tongcheng, Shucheng, Qianshan, Taihu, and the other counties could no longer be held.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Li Xubin was killed at Sanhe, and Tongcheng, Shucheng, Qianshan, Taihu, and the other counties could no longer be held.

sentences.zh: 安慶圍師牽動，多隆阿退保宿​​松。

translations.literal: The Anqing besieging force was drawn away; Dolong'a withdrew to defend Susong.
translations.idiomatic: The Anqing siege force was pulled away, and Dolong'a withdrew to hold Susong.

sentences.zh: 次日，賊麕至，值大霧，多隆阿驅勁騎陷陣，敢死士隨之，斫殺無算。

translations.literal: The next day rebels poured in; there was heavy fog; Dolong'a drove elite cavalry into the enemy ranks; dare-to-die troops followed; hewed and killed beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels poured in through heavy fog. Dolong'a drove his best cavalry into the enemy ranks, with dare-to-die troops close behind, and cut down the enemy beyond count.

sentences.zh: 鮑超軍夾擊，呼聲震天，賊驚潰，自相踐踏，陳玉成精銳損失過半。

translations.literal: Bao Chao's army struck from both sides; shouts shook heaven; the rebels fled in panic, trampling one another; Chen Yucheng's elite troops lost more than half.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao's army struck from both flanks with shouts that shook the sky. The rebels broke in panic and trampled one another, and Chen Yucheng lost more than half of his best troops.

sentences.zh: 自三河失利後，得此捷，軍聲复震。

translations.literal: After the defeat at Sanhe, with this victory army prestige revived.
translations.idiomatic: After the disaster at Sanhe, this victory restored the army's prestige.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，都興阿以病離營，奏多隆阿素當前敵，請所部悉令統帶。

translations.literal: That winter Doxingga left camp because of illness and memorialized that Dolong'a had long faced the front line and requested that his entire command be placed under his unified leadership.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Doxingga left camp because of illness and memorialized that Dolong'a had long borne the brunt of the fighting, asking that his entire command be placed under Dolong'a's unified leadership.

sentences.zh: 詔責成督率將士，就近聽胡林翼調度。

translations.literal: An edict charged him to command and lead the officers and soldiers and, in his vicinity, to accept Hu Linyi's direction.
translations.idiomatic: An edict charged him to command his officers and men and, in the field, to accept Hu Linyi's direction.

sentences.zh: 九年春，進逼太湖。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year he advanced against Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the ninth year he pressed toward Taihu.

sentences.zh: 諸將猶謂賊銳，宜稍避，多隆阿曰：「不入虎穴，焉得虎子？」

translations.literal: The generals still said the rebels were fierce and that he ought to avoid them somewhat. Dolong'a said: "If you do not enter the tiger's den, how can you catch the tiger cub?"
translations.idiomatic: The other generals still said the rebels were too strong and that he ought to hold back. Dolong'a said, "If you do not enter the tiger's den, how can you catch the tiger cub?"

sentences.zh: 賊憑城出鬥，力戰挫之，營壘乃就。

translations.literal: The rebels relied on the walls to come out and fight; he fought hard and broke them; the encampments were then established.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels sallied from the walls to fight; he broke them after hard combat, and the encampments were finally established.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼遣唐訓方會攻，而石牌復為賊踞，攻太湖城連月不克。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi sent Tang Xunfang to join the attack, but Shipai was again occupied by rebels; the assault on Taihu city went on for months without success.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi sent Tang Xunfang to join the attack, but Shipai had fallen to the rebels again, and the assault on Taihu city dragged on for months without success.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿謂必先取石牌而後太湖可下，乃選精銳，自茶婆嶺進兵，用火攻困之。

translations.literal: Dolong'a said Shipai must be taken first before Taihu could fall; he selected elite troops and advanced from Chapoling, using fire attack to hem them in.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a said Shipai had to be taken before Taihu could fall. He chose elite troops, advanced from Chapoling, and used fire to hem the enemy in.

sentences.zh: 賊由潛山、安慶兩路來援，分馬隊擊卻之。

translations.literal: Rebels came to reinforce from Qianshan and Anqing by two routes; he divided cavalry and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels came to reinforce from Qianshan and Anqing along two routes, and he sent cavalry to drive them back.

sentences.zh: 九月，复猛攻，焚其壘，殲賊酋霍天燕、石廷玉等，遂克石牌，令部將雷正綰駐守之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he again attacked fiercely, burned their stockade, killed the rebel chiefs Huo Tianyan, Shi Tingyu, and others, then took Shipai and ordered his subordinate Lei Zhengwan to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he attacked again with full force, burned their stockade, and killed the rebel chiefs Huo Tianyan, Shi Tingyu, and others. Shipai then fell, and he left his subordinate Lei Zhengwan to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 時湘軍圍安慶，陳玉成糾合捻匪縱十餘萬來援，太湖當其衝。

translations.literal: At the time the Hunan army besieged Anqing; Chen Yucheng mustered Nian bandits totaling more than a hundred thousand to reinforce; Taihu lay in their path.
translations.idiomatic: While the Hunan army besieged Anqing, Chen Yucheng gathered more than a hundred thousand Nian bandits to relieve the city, and Taihu lay directly in their path.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼調集諸將為備，多隆阿已授福州副都統，戰略威望最著，遂令前敵諸軍並受節制。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi assembled the generals in preparation; Dolong'a had already been appointed Fuzhou vice banner commander; his strategic prestige was most prominent, so all front-line armies were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi assembled the generals to prepare. Dolong'a had already been made vice banner commander at Fuzhou, and his strategic prestige stood highest, so every front-line army was placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 歲將盡，賊分三路至，鮑超屯小池驛，蔣凝學屯龍家涼亭，多隆阿自以馬步各隊駐新倉，硃品隆與唐訓方合軍仍圍太湖，初戰，中賊伏，頗有傷亡。

translations.literal: As the year drew to a close, rebels came by three routes; Bao Chao encamped at Xiaochiyi; Jiang Ningxue at Longjialangting; Dolong'a personally stationed mixed cavalry and infantry at Xincang; Zhu Pinlong and Tang Xunfang combined forces still besieging Taihu; in the first battle they fell into a rebel ambush and suffered considerable casualties.
translations.idiomatic: As the year drew to a close, the rebels came by three routes. Bao Chao encamped at Xiaochiyi, Jiang Ningxue at Longjialangting, and Dolong'a posted mixed cavalry and infantry at Xincang, while Zhu Pinlong and Tang Xunfang kept up the siege of Taihu. In the first engagement they walked into an ambush and took heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 賊勢專趨小池驛，鮑軍為所困。

translations.literal: The rebel strength concentrated on Xiaochiyi; Bao's army was pinned.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel main force pressed Xiaochiyi, and Bao Chao's army was pinned down.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿慮牽動局勢，僅分隊為護餉道。

translations.literal: Dolong'a feared upsetting the overall situation and only detached a unit to protect the supply route.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a feared that moving more troops would upset the whole front and detached only a small force to guard the supply line.

sentences.zh: 會金國琛等軍出潛山高橫嶺、仰天庵，密約夾攻。

translations.literal: Just then Jin Guochen's army and others came out from Gaohengleng and Yangtian'an in Qianshan; they secretly agreed on a pincer attack.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Jin Guochen's force and others came out from Gaohengleng and Yangtian'an in Qianshan, and the two sides secretly agreed on a pincer attack.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，賊移壘羅山沖、白沙畈，與城賊互應。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year the rebels shifted their stockades to Luoshanchong and Baishafan, coordinating with the city rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year the rebels shifted their camps to Luoshanchong and Baishafan, coordinating with the garrison inside the city.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿定計以大圍包裹援賊，以伏兵橫截城賊，令步隊誘敵，馬隊驟起圍擊。

translations.literal: Dolong'a devised a plan to encircle the relief rebels in a great cordon, cut off city rebels with ambush troops, use infantry to lure the enemy, and have cavalry rise suddenly to surround and strike.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a planned to wrap the relief force in a great encirclement, cut off the city garrison with ambush troops, use infantry to draw the enemy out, and then have cavalry rise suddenly to surround and strike.

sentences.zh: 唐訓方鈔其後，硃品隆扼其右，鮑超遏其前，自率馬步衝突陷陣，賊大敗。

translations.literal: Tang Xunfang attacked from behind, Zhu Pinlong blocked the right, Bao Chao blocked the front; Dolong'a personally led cavalry and infantry charging into the ranks; the rebels were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Xunfang struck from behind, Zhu Pinlong held the right, and Bao Chao blocked the front, while Dolong'a personally led cavalry and infantry in a charge through the enemy ranks. The rebels were routed.

sentences.zh: 次日，分軍三路，鮑超等東出小池驛，硃品隆等西趨羅山沖，多隆阿自居中路，見賊屯袤廣二十餘里，陳玉成踞羅山沖，尤為悍賊所聚，列隊進攻，為賊陣所壓，遂督中西兩路效力攻山，奮呼直上，賊始敗竄。

translations.literal: The next day he divided the army into three routes; Bao Chao and others went east from Xiaochiyi; Zhu Pinlong and others went west toward Luoshanchong; Dolong'a himself took the center route; he saw rebel encampments stretching more than twenty li; Chen Yucheng held Luoshanchong, where the fiercest rebels were gathered; he formed ranks and attacked but was pressed by the rebel formation; he then directed the center and west routes to exert themselves attacking the hill, shouting as they charged upward; only then did the rebels flee in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he split his army into three columns. Bao Chao went east from Xiaochiyi, Zhu Pinlong west toward Luoshanchong, and Dolong'a took the center. Rebel camps stretched more than twenty li, with Chen Yucheng at Luoshanchong where the fiercest fighters were gathered. His first assault was driven back, so he drove the center and western columns up the hill with shouts and hard fighting until the rebels finally broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 鮑超亦由小池驛連破四路之賊，合隊追奔，同攻賊壘，乘風縱火，賊柵、賊館頃刻延燒，大小營壘百餘，一律平毀。

translations.literal: Bao Chao also from Xiaochiyi broke rebels along four routes in succession; combined forces pursued; together they attacked the rebel stockades; riding the wind they set fires; rebel palisades and rebel lodges were ablaze in moments; more than a hundred large and small camps were all levelled.
translations.idiomatic: From Xiaochiyi, Bao Chao broke rebels along four routes in succession. The combined columns pursued together, stormed the rebel camps, and set fires that spread with the wind until palisades and lodges were ablaze in moments. More than a hundred camps, large and small, were levelled.

sentences.zh: 金國琛等沿山兜擊，賊前後受敵，奪路狂竄，連夜追剿，擒斬無算。

translations.literal: Jin Guochen and others struck along the mountain slopes; the rebels were attacked front and rear; they seized routes and fled wildly; pursuit continued through the night; captured and killed beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Guochen and others struck along the slopes, and the rebels were caught front and rear. They broke and fled wildly, and the pursuit went on through the night with captures and kills beyond count.

sentences.zh: 城賊聞敗，宵遁，伏兵四起，截殺未逸者，盡數殲之，即日克復太湖，乘勝追賊至潛山城下，亦克之。

translations.literal: The city rebels heard of the defeat and fled by night; ambush troops rose everywhere, cut down those who could not escape, and destroyed them all; Taihu was recovered that same day; riding the victory he pursued the rebels to the walls of Qianshan and took that too.
translations.idiomatic: The city garrison heard of the defeat and fled by night. Ambush troops rose on every side and cut down those who could not escape. Taihu was recovered that same day, and riding the victory he pursued the rebels to the walls of Qianshan and took that city as well.

sentences.zh: 是役時稱奇捷，推多隆阿首功，詔加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: This battle was at the time called a marvelous victory; Dolong'a was credited with the chief merit; an edict granted the first-rank official's hat button.
translations.idiomatic: The battle was hailed at the time as a remarkable victory, with Dolong'a credited as chief contributor. An edict granted him the first-rank official's hat button.

sentences.zh: 賊既敗，回踞桐城，增壘為固。

translations.literal: After their defeat the rebels returned to hold Tongcheng and added fortifications to strengthen it.
translations.idiomatic: After their defeat the rebels fell back on Tongcheng and strengthened their fortifications.

sentences.zh: 七月，多隆阿率軍進逼城西，晝夜環攻，其西北山岡曰毛狗洞，賊壘最據形勢，攻下之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Dolong'a led his army to press the west of the city, attacking round the clock; a northwestern hillock was called Maogoudong; the rebel stockade there held the strongest position; he took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Dolong'a led his army against the west of the city and attacked around the clock. On a northwestern hill called Maogoudong stood the rebels' strongest stockade, and he took it.

sentences.zh: 俯瞰全城，掘隧道轟之，未克。

translations.literal: Overlooking the whole city, he dug tunnels and blasted, but did not succeed in taking it.
translations.idiomatic: From there he overlooked the whole city, dug tunnels, and blasted the walls, but still could not take it.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成復糾捻匪自舒城來援，十月，於掛車河隔河而陣，連戰敗之。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng again mustered Nian bandits from Shucheng to reinforce; in the tenth month at Guachehe they drew up formations across the river and repeatedly defeated them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng again gathered Nian bandits from Shucheng to reinforce the city. In the tenth month at Guachehe the two sides drew up across the river, and Dolong'a defeated them in battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 復與李續宜約期合攻，裹賊於中，戰酣，以馬隊鈔擊，賊大敗，殲殪近萬，解散脅從萬餘，賊棄壘夜遁，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Again he agreed with Li Xuyi on a date for a combined attack, enveloping the rebels in the center; as battle grew fierce, cavalry struck from the rear; the rebels were utterly defeated; nearly ten thousand were killed; more than ten thousand coerced followers were disbanded; the rebels abandoned their stockades and fled by night; he was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He again agreed with Li Xuyi on a joint attack that enveloped the rebels in the center. As the battle reached its height, cavalry struck from the rear and routed them. Nearly ten thousand were killed, more than ten thousand coerced followers were released, and the rebels abandoned their camps and fled by night. Dolong'a was granted the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成屢為多隆阿所挫，知不敵，乃謀犯湖北。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng had been repeatedly defeated by Dolong'a; knowing he could not prevail, he then plotted to invade Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng had been beaten again and again by Dolong'a. Knowing he could not prevail, he turned instead toward invading Hubei.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，又糾眾繞英、霍，陷蘄水，掠黃州、德安。

translations.literal: That winter he again mustered troops, circled through Yingzhou and Huozhou, took Qishui, and plundered Huangzhou and De'an.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he gathered troops again, swung through Yingzhou and Huozhou, took Qishui, and raided Huangzhou and De'an.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，折回趨安慶，經掛車河，耀兵而過。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year he turned back toward Anqing, passed Guachehe, and displayed his forces as he went.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year he turned back toward Anqing, passed through Guachehe, and paraded his forces as he went.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿曰：「此示假道，不欲戰也。」

translations.literal: Dolong'a said: "This shows a feigned passage; they do not wish to fight."
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a said, "This is only a feigned passage. They do not mean to fight."

sentences.zh: 設伏山隘，令賊過呼噪勿擊，而以輕騎躡之，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: He set ambushes in the mountain passes, ordered that when the rebels passed the troops shout but not strike, and then followed with light cavalry; heads taken were very many.
translations.idiomatic: He laid ambushes in the mountain passes and ordered his men to shout as the rebels passed but not to attack, then followed with light cavalry and took a great many heads.

sentences.zh: 玉成入安慶，築壘集賢關，多隆阿進駐高路埔。

translations.literal: Yucheng entered Anqing and built stockades at Jixian Pass; Dolong'a advanced to garrison Gaolupu.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng entered Anqing and built stockades at Jixian Pass, while Dolong'a advanced to garrison Gaolupu.

sentences.zh: 桐城、廬江諸賊二萬餘，將與玉成聯合。

translations.literal: Rebels at Tongcheng, Lujiang, and elsewhere, more than twenty thousand, were about to join with Yucheng.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty thousand rebels at Tongcheng, Lujiang, and elsewhere were about to join forces with Yucheng.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿分五路進擊，迭敗之於練潭、橫山堡、金神墩、新安渡，餘賊遁回桐城。

translations.literal: Dolong'a divided into five routes and advanced; defeated them in succession at Liantan, Hengshanbao, Jinshendun, and Xin'an Ford; the remaining rebels fled back to Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a divided his force into five columns and defeated them in succession at Liantan, Hengshanbao, Jinshendun, and Xin'an Ford. The survivors fled back to Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 未幾，悍賊黃文金糾眾二萬餘踞天林莊，擊走之。

translations.literal: Before long the fierce rebel Huang Wenjin mustered more than twenty thousand and held Tianlinzhuang; Dolong'a struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the fierce rebel Huang Wenjin gathered more than twenty thousand men and held Tianlinzhuang. Dolong'a attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成留悍黨守集賢關，自率馬步五六千竄馬踏石，欲與桐城諸賊會合。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng left fierce partisans to hold Jixian Pass and personally led five or six thousand horse and foot to slip through Matashi, intending to join with the Tongcheng rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng left his fiercest fighters to hold Jixian Pass and personally led five or six thousand horse and foot to slip through Matashi, hoping to join the Tongcheng rebels.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿要擊於河岸，卻之。

translations.literal: Dolong'a intercepted them at the riverbank and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a intercepted them at the riverbank and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 四月，玉成復率諸酋合粵、捻三萬餘人圖上犯，以解安慶之圍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Yucheng again led various chiefs, combining Cantonese and Nian rebels totaling more than thirty thousand, planning to advance northward and lift the siege of Anqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Yucheng again led various chiefs, combining Cantonese and Nian rebels numbering more than thirty thousand, in a planned thrust northward to relieve the siege of Anqing.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿分路設伏，扼之於掛車河，左右往來衝擊，伏發，四面夾攻，殲斃八九千，追剿，五戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Dolong'a set ambushes along divided routes and blocked them at Guachehe; forces struck back and forth on both flanks; ambushes rose; attacked from all sides; eight or nine thousand were killed; pursuit continued; five battles were all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a set ambushes along several routes and blocked them at Guachehe. His columns struck back and forth on both flanks, ambushes rose on every side, and eight or nine thousand were killed. The pursuit continued through five battles, all of them victories.

sentences.zh: 賊仍退桐城，安慶之援遂絕。

translations.literal: The rebels still retreated to Tongcheng; relief for Anqing was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back to Tongcheng again, and relief for Anqing was cut off.

sentences.zh: 官文、胡林翼疏陳多隆阿樸誠忠勇，智略冠軍，為眾所悅服，於是奉幫辦軍務之命。

translations.literal: Guan Wen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Dolong'a was plain, sincere, loyal, and brave, that his strategy surpassed the army, and that all were pleased to follow him; he then received orders to assist in managing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen and Hu Linyi memorialized that Dolong'a was plain, sincere, loyal, and brave, that his strategy surpassed the whole army, and that all were glad to follow him. He then received orders to assist in managing military affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，安慶克復，急令穆圖善攻桐城，即日克之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Anqing was recovered; he urgently ordered Mu Tushan to attack Tongcheng; it was taken the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Anqing was recovered. He urgently ordered Mu Tushan to attack Tongcheng, and the city fell the same day.

sentences.zh: 數日中連克宿松、黃梅，而舒城賊亦棄城走廬州，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Within several days he took Susong and Huangmei in succession; the Shucheng rebels also abandoned the city and fled toward Luzhou; he was granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few days he took Susong and Huangmei in succession. The Shucheng rebels also abandoned their city and fled toward Luzhou, and he was granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 擢正紅旗蒙古都統，又擢荊州將軍。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Mongol banner commander of the Plain Red Banner, and again promoted to Jingzhou garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Mongol banner commander of the Plain Red Banner and then to Jingzhou garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 進規廬州，同治元年春，連破賊，絕其運道，賊黨相率投誠，散遣千餘人。

translations.literal: He advanced against Luzhou; in the spring of the first year of Tongzhi he defeated rebels in succession, cut their supply routes; rebel bands surrendered in groups; more than a thousand were released and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against Luzhou. In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi he defeated the rebels in succession, cut their supply routes, and received groups of surrenders, releasing more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 四月，大破援賊，陳玉成戰敗不敢入城，竄​​走，遂克廬州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he utterly defeated the relief rebels; Chen Yucheng was defeated and dared not enter the city; he fled; Luzhou was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he routed the relief force. Chen Yucheng was beaten and dared not enter the city, so he fled, and Luzhou then fell.

sentences.zh: 令穆圖善、雷正綰追玉成，玉成奔壽州，為練總苗沛霖擒獻勝保營，誅之。

translations.literal: He ordered Mu Tushan and Lei Zhengwan to pursue Yucheng; Yucheng fled to Shouzhou, was captured by militia commander Miao Peilin and sent to Sheng Bao's camp, and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Mu Tushan and Lei Zhengwan to pursue Yucheng. Yucheng fled to Shouzhou, was seized by the militia commander Miao Peilin, and sent to Sheng Bao's camp, where he was executed.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，優詔褒嘉，加予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, a gracious edict praised and rewarded him, adding the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory arrived, an edict praised and rewarded him and added the hereditary office of Commandant of Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尋命督辦陝西軍務，率所部西征。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to supervise Shaanxi military affairs and led his command west on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise military affairs in Shaanxi and led his command west on campaign.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪陳得才合捻匪姜臺凌、張​​洛行眾二十萬，三路窺陝。

translations.literal: At the time the Cantonese rebel Chen Decai combined with Nian bandits Jiang Tailin and Zhang Luoxing, their forces totaling two hundred thousand, and watched Shaanxi along three routes.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Cantonese rebel Chen Decai had joined with the Nian bandits Jiang Tailin and Zhang Luoxing in a force of two hundred thousand, and they threatened Shaanxi along three routes.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿令雷正綰、陶茂林率三千人前驅，大軍繼之，七月，抵商南。

translations.literal: Dolong'a ordered Lei Zhengwan and Tao Maolin to lead three thousand men as advance guard; the main army followed; in the seventh month they reached Shangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a sent Lei Zhengwan and Tao Maolin ahead with three thousand men, followed by the main army, and in the seventh month they reached Shangnan.

sentences.zh: 陳得才躡後路，圖截餉道，乃率穆圖善回軍掩擊，大破賊於荊子關。

translations.literal: Chen Decai tracked their rear route, intending to cut the supply line; Dolong'a then led Mu Tushan back to strike from cover and utterly defeated the rebels at Jingziguan.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Decai tracked their line of march and tried to cut the supply route. Dolong'a turned back with Mu Tushan, struck from cover, and routed the rebels at Jingziguan.

sentences.zh: 賊夜遁，令馬隊追賊，步隊休息，自攜數十人入商南，姜臺凌大隊突薄城下。

translations.literal: The rebels fled by night; he ordered cavalry to pursue the rebels and infantry to rest; he himself entered Shangnan with several dozen men; Jiang Tailin's main force suddenly pressed close beneath the walls.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled by night. Dolong'a sent cavalry in pursuit and let the infantry rest, while he himself entered Shangnan with only several dozen men. Then Jiang Tailin's main force suddenly pressed up to the walls.

sentences.zh: 調衛隊四營猶未至，陽示鎮靜，設伏城外，親率百餘人開城衝出，伏兵齊應，賊不知眾寡，倉皇退竄。

translations.literal: The four battalions of the guard corps he had summoned had not yet arrived; outwardly he showed calm, set ambushes outside the city, personally led more than a hundred men to open the gates and charge out; ambush troops responded together; the rebels did not know his numbers and retreated in haste.
translations.idiomatic: The four guard battalions he had summoned had not yet arrived. Outwardly he remained calm, laid ambushes outside the city, and personally led more than a hundred men in a sortie through the gates. The ambush troops rose together, and the rebels, unable to tell his numbers, fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 次日，復出城誘戰，正與相持，總兵硃希廣率四營由間道來援，連日力戰，擒斬二千餘，賊乃西竄，檄溫德勒克西馬隊要截，王萬年步隊躡追。

translations.literal: The next day he again went out to lure battle; while locked in combat, Brigadier Zhu Xiguang led four battalions by a hidden route to reinforce; for consecutive days they fought hard; more than two thousand were captured and killed; the rebels then fled west; he issued orders for Wendelekexi's cavalry to intercept and Wang Wannian's infantry to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he went out again to draw the enemy into battle. While the two sides were locked in combat, Brigadier Zhu Xiguang arrived with four battalions by a hidden route. They fought hard for days, capturing and killing more than two thousand. The rebels then fled west, and Dolong'a ordered Wendelekexi's cavalry to intercept them and Wang Wannian's infantry to pursue.

sentences.zh: 金順守荊子關，陶茂林遏武關，自率親軍於捉馬溝築壘，賊夜來襲，俟其近，排槍砲擊之，穆圖善自外夾攻，斃賊無算。

translations.literal: Jin Shun guarded Jingziguan; Tao Maolin blocked Wuguan; Dolong'a personally led his personal guard to build stockades at Zhuomagou; rebels came to attack by night; when they drew near, volleys of muskets and cannon struck them; Mu Tushan attacked from outside in pincer; rebels killed beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun held Jingziguan and Tao Maolin blocked Wuguan, while Dolong'a personally led his guard to build stockades at Zhuomagou. The rebels attacked by night, and when they drew near he opened with volleys of muskets and cannon. Mu Tushan struck from outside in pincer, and the rebels fell beyond count.

sentences.zh: 至曉，見賊蟻聚，亙數十里，令降俘指認賊旗居中之紅邊白旗為姜臺凌，先集攻之。

translations.literal: By dawn he saw rebels swarming like ants for several tens of li; he had surrendered captives identify the red-bordered white banner at the center of the rebel flags as Jiang Tailin's; he concentrated forces first to attack it.
translations.idiomatic: By dawn he saw the rebels swarming for miles. He had surrendered captives point out the red-bordered white banner at the center of the enemy flags as Jiang Tailin's, and concentrated his force to attack it first.

sentences.zh: 戰方酣，自率穆圖善從山側繞擊，賊敗如山倒，斫殺萬計，追至三角池，截其尾隊。

translations.literal: As battle grew fierce he personally led Mu Tushan in a flanking strike from the mountain side; the rebels collapsed like a falling mountain; more than ten thousand were hewed and killed; pursuit reached Sanjiaochi and cut off their rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: As the battle reached its height he personally led Mu Tushan in a flanking strike from the mountainside. The rebels collapsed like a landslide, more than ten thousand were cut down, and the pursuit reached Sanjiaochi, where the rearguard was cut off.

sentences.zh: 姜臺凌僅以身免，張洛行聞風亦遁。

translations.literal: Jiang Tailin escaped with his life alone; Zhang Luoxing, hearing the news, also fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Tailin escaped with his life alone, and Zhang Luoxing fled as soon as he heard the news.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其旬日內剿除巨寇，頒賜黃馬褂及江綢刀《角枼》，以示優異。

translations.literal: An edict praised him for wiping out great bandits within ten days and bestowed the yellow riding jacket, a Yangtze silk sash, a knife, and a horn powder flask as marks of special favor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him for destroying the great rebel force within ten days and bestowed the yellow riding jacket, a Yangtze silk sash, a knife, and a horn powder flask as marks of special favor.

sentences.zh: 時勝保入陝督師，移多隆阿赴南陽防剿，連敗賊於樊城、唐縣。

translations.literal: At the time Sheng Bao entered Shaanxi to take command; Dolong'a was shifted to Nanyang for defense and suppression; he defeated rebels in succession at Fancheng and Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sheng Bao entered Shaanxi to take command and shifted Dolong'a to Nanyang for defense and suppression. Dolong'a defeated the rebels in succession at Fancheng and Tang County.

sentences.zh: 尋復命赴陝。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered to go to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered back to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，入潼關。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he entered Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he entered Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 勝保以罪逮，詔授多隆阿欽差大臣，督辦軍務。

translations.literal: Sheng Bao was arrested on charges; an edict appointed Dolong'a Imperial Commissioner and charged him to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Bao was arrested on charges, and an edict appointed Dolong'a Imperial Commissioner with charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 回匪方熾，遍擾東西北三路，陝南則為粵、捻、川匪所出沒。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels were then raging, troubling the eastern, northern, and western routes everywhere; southern Shaanxi was haunted by Cantonese, Nian, and Sichuan bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim rebels were then at their height, raiding the eastern, northern, and western routes everywhere, while southern Shaanxi was overrun by Cantonese, Nian, and Sichuan bandits.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿令雷正綰任西路，自剿東路，克韓村、背坡諸賊營，同州解圍。

translations.literal: Dolong'a assigned Lei Zhengwan to the western route and himself suppressed the eastern route; he took the rebel camps at Hancun, Beipo, and elsewhere; Tongzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a put Lei Zhengwan in charge of the western route and himself cleared the eastern route, taking the rebel camps at Hancun, Beipo, and elsewhere and relieving Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年春，督軍並攻王閣村、羌白鎮，破之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year he directed the armies in a joint attack on Wanggecun and Qiangbaizhen and broke them.
