translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year he directed a joint assault on Wanggecun and Qiangbaizhen and broke both positions.

sentences.zh: 回匪自倡亂，至是始被痛創，遂進攻倉頭鎮。

translations.literal: Since the Muslim rebels had risen in revolt, only now did they suffer a severe blow; he then advanced to attack Cangtouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Muslim rebels had risen in revolt, only now did they suffer a severe blow, and he advanced to attack Cangtouzhen.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿積勞致病，將士亦多染疫，遣將分攻龐谷、雷化、喬千、孝義諸鎮，皆克，惟倉頭為老巢，負嵎未下。

translations.literal: Dolong'a fell ill from accumulated strain; many officers and soldiers also contracted epidemic disease; he sent generals to attack separately Penggu, Leihua, Qiaoqian, Xiaoyi, and other towns; all were taken; only Cangtou, the old lair, held fast in defiance and was not yet taken.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a fell ill from overwork, and many of his officers and soldiers were stricken with epidemic disease. He sent generals to attack Penggu, Leihua, Qiaoqian, Xiaoyi, and other towns in separate columns, and all fell. Only Cangtou, their old lair, still held out in stubborn defiance.

sentences.zh: 四月，移營進逼，揮軍縱擊​​，破其土城，賊大奔，追殺無算，東路肅清。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he shifted camp to press close; he waved his army forward in full assault; broke their earthen wall; rebels fled in great disorder; pursuit and slaughter were beyond count; the eastern route was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he moved camp closer and launched a full assault, broke their earthen wall, and put the rebels to rout. The pursuit left dead beyond count, and the eastern route was cleared.

sentences.zh: 令曹克忠一軍赴西安護運道，自率穆圖善等攻高陵，分路夾擊，八月，克之，掃蕩附近賊巢。

translations.literal: He ordered Cao Kezhong's army to go to Xi'an to guard the supply route; he personally led Mu Tushan and others to attack Gaoling; divided routes struck in pincer; in the eighth month it was taken; nearby rebel nests were swept clean.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Cao Kezhong's army to Xi'an to guard the supply route and personally led Mu Tushan and others against Gaoling in a pincer attack. The city fell in the eighth month, and nearby rebel nests were swept clean.

sentences.zh: 關輔略定，而漢南諸賊紛擾。

translations.literal: The capital region was roughly pacified, but rebels in southern Han were still in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: The region around the capital was roughly pacified, but rebels in southern Han were still in turmoil.

sentences.zh: 川匪藍朝柱近踞盩厔，三年春，親督兵力攻，城小而固，多隆阿憤甚，臨高指揮督戰，城已垂破，忽中槍，傷頭目，將士攻城益力，旋克之。

translations.literal: The Sichuan rebel Lan Chaozhu had recently occupied Zhouzhi. In the spring of the third year, Dolong'a personally led his troops in the assault. The city was small but strong. Dolong'a was greatly angered; from a height he directed and supervised the battle. The city was already on the verge of falling when he was suddenly struck by a bullet, wounded in the head, but the officers and soldiers pressed the assault all the harder and soon took it.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan rebel Lan Chaozhu had recently seized Zhouzhi. In the spring of the third year Dolong'a personally led the assault. The city was small but stubborn, and Dolong'a, furious, commanded the fight from a height. The walls were already giving way when he was struck by a bullet and wounded in the head. His officers and men redoubled the attack and soon took the city.

sentences.zh: 事聞，溫詔慰勞，賜上方藥，遣其子馳驛省視。

translations.literal: When word reached the throne, a gracious edict comforted and rewarded him, imperial medicine was bestowed, and his son was dispatched by post-horse to visit him.
translations.idiomatic: When the news reached court, the emperor issued a warm edict of commendation, sent imperial medicine, and dispatched his son by courier to visit him.

sentences.zh: 尋命督辦陝、甘兩省軍務。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise military affairs in Shaanxi and Gansu provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed to supervise military affairs in Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 四月，創甚，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month his wounds were severe, and he died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month his wounds proved mortal, and he died in the field.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，予一等輕車都尉世職，入祀京師昭忠祠，立功地建專祠，諡忠勇。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, given a first-class hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots, entered worship in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty at the capital, granted a special temple at the place of his achievement, and given the posthumous title Zhongyong, Loyal and Brave.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted a first-class hereditary Commandant of Light Chariots, enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty at the capital, given a special temple where he had won distinction, and honored with the posthumous title Zhongyong, Loyal and Brave.

sentences.zh: 未幾，江寧复，加一云騎尉，並為一等男爵。

translations.literal: Before long Jiangning was recovered, and he was given an additional Cloud Cavalry Commandant, together making a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Not long afterward Jiangning was recovered, and an additional Cloud Cavalry Commandant was added to his honors, raising the whole to a first-class barony.

sentences.zh: 子雙全襲，官頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: His son Shuangquan inherited the title and held the office of First Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shuangquan inherited the honors and served as a First Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 孫壽長，光緒中，官正黃旗滿洲副都統，統奉天仁字軍，因事革職。

translations.literal: Sun Shouzhang, in the Guangxu reign, held the office of vice banner commander of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, commanded the Fengtian Ren-character army, and was dismissed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Shouzhang, during the Guangxu reign, served as vice banner commander of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner and commanded the Fengtian Ren-character army before being dismissed for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，俄兵入邊，壽長力請戰，召回京，未行，為俄人所執，不屈死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Russian troops entered the frontier. Shouzhang urgently petitioned to fight. He was recalled to the capital, but before he could depart he was seized by the Russians and died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, when Russian troops crossed the border, Shouzhang pleaded urgently to be allowed to fight. He was recalled to the capital, but before he could set out he was captured by the Russians and died rather than submit.

sentences.zh: 鮑超，字春霆，四川奉節人。

translations.literal: Bao Chao, style Chunting, was a native of Fengjie in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao, whose style was Chunting, came from Fengjie in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，以行伍從提督向榮廣西剿匪，尋入湖南協標。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianfeng he entered service as a common soldier and followed Regional Commander Xiang Rong to suppress rebels in Guangxi; soon afterward he entered the Hunan auxiliary garrison.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Xianfeng reign he enlisted and followed Regional Commander Xiang Rong to suppress rebels in Guangxi, then transferred into the Hunan auxiliary garrison.

sentences.zh: 四年，曾國籓治水師，調充哨長。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Zeng Guofan organized the river fleet and transferred him to serve as a squad leader.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Zeng Guofan raised a river fleet and assigned Bao Chao as a squad leader.

sentences.zh: 勇銳過人，每以單舸衝賊隊，當者辟易。

translations.literal: His courage and sharpness surpassed others; he often charged rebel formations alone in a single boat, and those who faced him gave way.
translations.idiomatic: He was fiercer and bolder than most men, and often drove a lone boat straight into rebel lines; anyone in his path fell back.

sentences.zh: 從克岳州、武昌、漢陽，破賊田家鎮、武穴，積功擢守備，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He took part in capturing Yuezhou, Wuchang, and Hankou, defeated rebels at Tianjiazhen and Wuxue, and through accumulated merit was promoted to garrison commander and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He helped take Yuezhou, Wuchang, and Hankou, broke the rebels at Tianjiazhen and Wuxue, and for repeated merit was promoted to garrison commander and awarded the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五年，武昌复陷，赴援，胡林翼拔充營官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Wuchang fell again; he went to its relief, and Hu Linyi selected him to serve as battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Wuchang fell again. Bao Chao marched to its relief, and Hu Linyi appointed him battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 擊賊於漢陽小河口、鮎魚套，屯沌口，破宗關賊壘，擢都司。

translations.literal: He struck rebels at Xiahekou and Nianyutao in Hankou, encamped at Zhunkou, broke the rebel stockade at Zongguan, and was promoted to battalion vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He fought the rebels at Xiahekou and Nianyutao in Hankou, encamped at Zhunkou, and stormed the rebel works at Zongguan, earning promotion to battalion vice commander.

sentences.zh: 會金口陸軍潰，賊聚攻胡林翼於高廟。

translations.literal: Just then the land army at Jinkou collapsed, and the rebels massed to attack Hu Linyi at Gaomiao.
translations.idiomatic: At that moment the land army at Jinkou broke, and the rebels gathered to assault Hu Linyi at Gaomiao.

sentences.zh: 超飛棹往救，力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Chao raced his boat to the rescue, fought fiercely, and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao raced his boats to the rescue, fought hard, and beat the rebels back.

sentences.zh: 德安、應城之賊復由溳口來犯，火其舟，拔林翼於重圍。

translations.literal: The rebels of De'an and Yingcheng again came to attack by way of Yuankou; he burned their boats and pulled Linyi out of a tight encirclement.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels from De'an and Yingcheng attacked again through Yuankou. He burned their boats and pulled Hu Linyi out of a heavy encirclement.

sentences.zh: 進搗賊營，右肋中砲，裹創而戰，復金口。

translations.literal: Advancing to storm the rebel camp, he was struck by cannon fire in the right side, bound his wound and kept fighting, and recovered Jinkou.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the rebel camp, he took a cannon shot in the right side, bound the wound, and fought on until Jinkou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 論功最，擢游擊，賜號壯勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Judged foremost in merit, he was promoted to mobile corps commander and granted the title Zhuangyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Rated highest for merit, he was promoted to mobile corps commander and granted the honorific title Zhuangyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 六年，林翼疏薦超勇敢冠軍，曉暢兵略，以水師總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Linyi memorialized recommending Chao as foremost in courage, well versed in military strategy, and registered him for appointment as river-fleet regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Hu Linyi memorialized that Bao Chao's courage led the army and that he understood strategy well, and had him registered for appointment as regional commander of the river fleet.

sentences.zh: 夏，會攻漢陽，扼沙口，斷賊往來，江面肅清，擢參將。

translations.literal: In summer he joined the assault on Hankou, held Shakou, cut rebel communications, cleared the river surface, and was promoted to brigade vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he joined the attack on Hankou, held Shakou, severed rebel communications, and cleared the river, earning promotion to brigade vice commander.

sentences.zh: 武昌既复，林翼令赴長沙募勇三千，創立霆字五營，改領陸軍。

translations.literal: Once Wuchang was recovered, Linyi ordered him to go to Changsha to recruit three thousand braves, establish the five Ting-character battalions, and transfer to command land forces.
translations.idiomatic: After Wuchang was recovered, Hu Linyi sent him to Changsha to raise three thousand braves, form the five Ting-character battalions, and take command of land troops.

sentences.zh: 七年，補陝西宜君營參將。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he received the substantive post of brigade vice commander in the Yijun Garrison of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed brigade vice commander of the Yijun Garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 攻小池口，破賊於孔壟，援黃梅。

translations.literal: He attacked Xiaochikou, defeated rebels at Konglong, and went to relieve Huangmei.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Xiaochikou, broke the rebels at Konglong, and marched to relieve Huangmei.

sentences.zh: 時總兵王國才戰歿濯港，賊甚張。

translations.literal: At the time Regional Commander Wang Guocai had been killed in battle at Zhuogang, and the rebels were very aggressive.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Wang Guocai had just been killed at Zhuogang, and the rebels were riding high.

sentences.zh: 眾議水陸暫扼守，超不可，主速戰，多隆阿讚之，以騎兵助攻億生寺賊壘。

translations.literal: The assembly debated holding the line on land and water for the moment; Chao would not agree and urged quick battle. Dolong'a approved and sent cavalry to assist in attacking the rebel stockade at Yisheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The commanders debated holding back on land and water, but Bao Chao refused and argued for a quick fight. Dolong'a agreed and sent cavalry to help attack the rebel stockade at Yisheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 戰一日夜，傷左膝右臂，不退，遂破黃蠟山賊巢，生擒賊渠，斬馘五千有奇。

translations.literal: The battle lasted a day and a night; he was wounded in the left knee and right arm but did not retreat, then broke the rebel nest at Huanglashan, captured the rebel chieftain alive, and killed more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The fighting lasted a day and a night. Wounded in the left knee and right arm, he still would not pull back, broke the rebel stronghold at Huanglashan, took the rebel chieftain alive, and killed more than five thousand men.

sentences.zh: 擢副將，加總兵銜。

translations.literal: He was promoted to brigade commander and given the rank of regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to brigade commander and granted the rank of regional commander.

sentences.zh: 乘勝焚黃梅後山，進屯宿松二郎河，平涼亭、祝家塝賊壘。

translations.literal: Riding the victory, he burned the rear hills of Huangmei, advanced and encamped at Erlanghe in Susong, and leveled the rebel stockades at Pingliangting and Zhujiapeng.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory, he burned the hills behind Huangmei, moved up to encamp at Erlanghe in Susong, and cleared the rebel works at Pingliangting and Zhujiapeng.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成擁眾數万踞楓香驛，連破之，奪其十三壘。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng held Fengxiang Post with a force of tens of thousands; Chao defeated him repeatedly and seized thirteen of his stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng held Fengxiang Post with tens of thousands of men. Bao Chao defeated him again and again and took thirteen of his stockades.

sentences.zh: 八年，援麻城，克黃安，偕多隆阿進規太湖。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he relieved Macheng, captured Huang'an, and together with Dolong'a advanced to invest Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he relieved Macheng, took Huang'an, and joined Dolong'a in advancing against Taihu.

sentences.zh: 超攻北門，燒賊火藥庫，破雷公埠、石牌賊營，斬馘萬餘，授湖南綏靖鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Chao attacked the north gate, burned the rebel powder magazine, broke the rebel camps at Leigongbu and Shipai, killed more than ten thousand, and was appointed regional commander of the Suijing Garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao assaulted the north gate, burned the rebel powder store, broke the camps at Leigongbu and Shipai, and killed more than ten thousand men. He was appointed regional commander of the Suijing Garrison in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 進攻安慶省城，而三河軍敗，陳玉成糾捻眾上犯，都興阿令超退守二郎河，遏賊衝。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack the provincial city of Anqing, but the army was defeated at Sanhe; Chen Yucheng gathered Nian bandits and marched upward to attack; Doxingga ordered Chao to withdraw and hold Erlanghe to block the rebel thrust.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced against the provincial city of Anqing, but the army was routed at Sanhe. Chen Yucheng rallied Nian bandits and marched north, and Doxingga ordered Bao Chao to fall back to Erlanghe and block the rebel drive.

sentences.zh: 超偕多隆阿大破賊於宿松東北花涼亭，斬偽成天侯韋廣新以下渠目三百餘，殲賊八千，散脅從數万。

translations.literal: Chao and Dolong'a together inflicted a great defeat on the rebels at Hualiangting northeast of Susong, beheading more than three hundred commanders below the false Chengtian Marquis Wei Guangxin, destroying eight thousand rebels, and dispersing tens of thousands of coerced followers.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao and Dolong'a won a great victory at Hualiangting northeast of Susong, beheading more than three hundred rebel commanders down to the false Chengtian Marquis Wei Guangxin, killing eight thousand rebels, and scattering tens of thousands of forced followers.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，優敘。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: On report of the victory he received special honors.

sentences.zh: 九年，會諸軍圍太湖，陳玉成糾眾十餘萬來援。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the allied armies besieged Taihu; Chen Yucheng gathered more than a hundred thousand men to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the allied armies besieged Taihu, and Chen Yucheng marched to its relief with more than a hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿總統諸軍，撤圍分屯，備大戰。

translations.literal: Dolong'a took overall command of the armies, lifted the siege, and divided the encampments to prepare for a great battle.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a assumed overall command, broke off the siege, and spread the armies in separate camps to prepare for a major battle.

sentences.zh: 超壁小池驛，十二月，賊至，壓超軍而壘，凡百餘座。

translations.literal: Chao fortified himself at Xiaochiyi. In the twelfth month the rebels arrived, pressed against Chao's army, and built stockades numbering more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao fortified himself at Xiaochiyi. In the twelfth month the rebels arrived, pressed his line, and threw up more than a hundred stockades.

sentences.zh: 超破其十餘壘，賊悉銳更番環逼，晝夜力禦，棚帳皆為砲裂，士卒傷痍，糧道將斷，超志氣彌奮，相持二十餘日。

translations.literal: Chao broke more than ten of their stockades, but the rebels sent all their best troops in rotating waves to surround and press him; day and night he fought hard to hold them off; tents and shelters were all shattered by cannon fire; officers and soldiers were wounded and exhausted; the supply route was nearly cut; yet Chao's spirit grew all the fiercer, and the stand lasted more than twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao stormed more than ten of their stockades, but the rebels sent wave after wave of their best troops to ring him in. Day and night he held them off as cannon fire tore through tents and shelters. His men were battered, supplies nearly exhausted, yet his resolve only hardened, and the stand lasted more than twenty days.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，援軍自潛山天堂出，諸軍乃約期夾擊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year relief troops came out from Tiantang in Qianshan, and the armies then set a date for a converging attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year relief troops emerged from Tiantang in Qianshan, and the armies fixed a date for a pincer attack.

sentences.zh: 超空壁而出，賊圍之數重，為方陣拒戰，四路賊皆破。

translations.literal: Chao left his fortifications empty and sallied out; the rebels surrounded him in many rings; he formed a square and fought them off, breaking the rebels on all four routes.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao left his works empty and sallied out. The rebels closed around him in ring after ring, but he formed a square, fought them off, and broke every one of the four rebel columns.

sentences.zh: 合諸軍盡焚賊壘，斬馘無算，遂克太湖。

translations.literal: The allied armies together burned all the rebel stockades, killed countless rebels, and then captured Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: The allied armies burned the rebel stockades to the ground, killed rebels beyond count, and at last took Taihu.

sentences.zh: 官文等奏捷，謂：「非超勇鷙堅強，以二千人獨御前敵，血戰兼旬，則援應各師，必有緩不濟急之勢。」

translations.literal: Guan Wen and others memorialized the victory, saying: "Had not Chao been fierce, resolute, and strong, holding the front alone with two thousand men in bloody battle for more than ten days, the relieving armies would surely have been too slow to meet the crisis."
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen and others reported the victory, declaring: "Had Bao Chao not been so fierce and unyielding, holding the front alone with two thousand men through more than ten days of bloody fighting, the relieving columns would surely have arrived too late to save the day."

sentences.zh: 詔加提督銜。

translations.literal: An edict added the rank of provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted him the rank of provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 超與多隆阿不相下，為胡林翼故，勉屈聽節制。

translations.literal: Chao and Dolong'a would not yield to each other; for Hu Linyi's sake he forced himself to submit and accept command.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao and Dolong'a were unwilling to defer to each other, but for Hu Linyi's sake he grudgingly submitted to Dolong'a's command.

sentences.zh: 臨危，多隆​​阿復不力救，雖成功，頗觖望，林翼慰解之，遂乞假省親去軍。

translations.literal: When danger came, Dolong'a again failed to rescue him vigorously; although the operation succeeded, he was quite resentful; Linyi comforted and reconciled him, but he then requested leave to visit his family and left the army.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis came Dolong'a again failed to rescue him with full force. Though the campaign succeeded, Bao Chao was deeply resentful. Hu Linyi tried to soothe him, but he asked for leave to visit his family and quit the field.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓方規皖南，奏令超增募萬人以從，未至，悍賊黃文金由浙入贛，李秀成亦由蕪湖上犯，取包圍遠勢。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan was then planning operations in southern Anhui and memorialized ordering Chao to raise ten thousand more men to follow him; before he arrived, the fierce rebel Huang Wenjin entered Jiangxi from Zhejiang, and Li Xiucheng also marched upward from Wuhu to attack, taking a distant encircling position.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan was then planning operations in southern Anhui and asked that Bao Chao raise ten thousand more men to join him. Before Bao Chao arrived, the fierce rebel Huang Wenjin entered Jiangxi from Zhejiang, and Li Xiucheng also marched up from Wuhu, seeking to envelop the government forces from afar.

sentences.zh: 詔促超赴軍，而寧國陷，褫勇號，責圖克復。

translations.literal: An edict urgently ordered Chao to join the army, but Ningguo fell; his brave title was stripped, and he was charged to recover it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict urgently summoned Bao Chao back to the field, but Ningguo had already fallen. His honorific brave title was stripped, and he was ordered to recover the city.

sentences.zh: 賊已直犯祁門大營，國籓兵單，誓死守。

translations.literal: The rebels had already struck straight at the great camp at Qimen; Guofan's troops were few, and he swore to hold firm to the death.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were already bearing down on the main camp at Qimen. Zeng Guofan's force was thin, but he vowed to hold the line to the death.

sentences.zh: 超至休寧，聞警，日馳百餘里，連戰皆捷，驅賊出嶺，國籓亦不意超軍遽至也。

translations.literal: Chao reached Xiuning, heard the alarm, raced more than a hundred li in a day, won victory in battle after battle, drove the rebels out of the mountain pass, and Guofan had not expected Chao's army to arrive so suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao reached Xiuning, heard the alarm, and raced more than a hundred li in a day. Battle after battle went his way, and he drove the rebels back over the pass. Zeng Guofan had not expected his army to arrive so swiftly.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其神速，賜號博通額巴圖魯。

translations.literal: An edict praised his swiftness and granted him the title Botonge Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended his speed and granted him the honorific title Botonge Batulu.

sentences.zh: 進援江西景德鎮，與左宗棠會剿，因雨遲至。

translations.literal: He advanced to relieve Jingdezhen in Jiangxi and joined Zuo Zongtang in joint suppression, but rain delayed his arrival.
translations.idiomatic: He marched to relieve Jingdezhen in Jiangxi and was to join Zuo Zongtang in a joint campaign, but rain delayed him.

sentences.zh: 宗棠假霆軍旗幟，賊見之卻走。

translations.literal: Zongtang borrowed the banners of the Ting army; at sight of them the rebels withdrew and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang borrowed the banners of Bao Chao's Ting army, and the rebels fell back at the sight of them.

sentences.zh: 復回踞洋塘、謝家灘。

translations.literal: They returned and again held Yangtang and Xiejiawan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fell back and reoccupied Yangtang and Xiejiawan.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，超至，大戰破之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year Chao arrived and, in a great battle, broke them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year Bao Chao arrived and routed them in a major battle.

sentences.zh: 黃文金負創遁，追敗之黃麥鋪，復建德。

translations.literal: Huang Wenjin fled wounded; Chao pursued and defeated him at Huangmaipu and recovered Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin fled with wounds. Bao Chao pursued, defeated him at Huangmaipu, and recovered Jiande.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奏請以超軍為江、皖游擊之師。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized requesting that Chao's army serve as a mobile strike force for Jiangxi and Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan memorialized that Bao Chao's army be made a mobile strike force for Jiangxi and Anhui.

sentences.zh: 陳玉成與安慶城賊夾攻官軍，頗為所困。

translations.literal: Chen Yucheng and the rebels in Anqing city attacked the government army from both sides, and it was greatly hard pressed.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yucheng and the rebels inside Anqing attacked the government forces from both sides and had them badly pinned down.

sentences.zh: 超渡江援之，大破賊於赤岡嶺，生擒悍黨劉瑲琳。

translations.literal: Chao crossed the river to relieve them, inflicted a great defeat on the rebels at Chigangling, and captured alive the fierce partisan Liu Qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao crossed the river to their relief, won a great victory at Chigangling, and captured the fierce rebel Liu Qilin alive.

sentences.zh: 既而李秀成犯江西，連陷二十餘城。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Li Xiucheng invaded Jiangxi and in succession captured more than twenty cities.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Li Xiucheng invaded Jiangxi and took more than twenty cities in succession.

sentences.zh: 超破之於樟樹鎮，斬馘萬餘，被珍賚。

translations.literal: Chao defeated him at Zhangshuzhen, killed more than ten thousand, and received precious rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao defeated him at Zhangshuzhen, killed more than ten thousand rebels, and received lavish rewards from the throne.

sentences.zh: 又進解撫州圍。

translations.literal: He then advanced and lifted the siege of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then marched forward and lifted the siege of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 調援江北，至南昌，聞安慶已克復，回軍戰於貴溪、雙港、湖坊河口，大破賊，遂克鉛山，解廣信圍，李秀成遁走。

translations.literal: He was transferred to relieve the north bank of the Yangtze, reached Nanchang, heard that Anqing had already been recovered, turned his army back, fought at Guixi, Shuanggang, and Hufanghekou, inflicted a great defeat on the rebels, then captured Qianshan, lifted the siege of Guangxin, and Li Xiucheng fled.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to relieve the north bank of the Yangtze, he reached Nanchang and learned that Anqing had already fallen to the government. He turned back, fought at Guixi, Shuanggang, and Hufanghekou, routed the rebels, took Qianshan, lifted the siege of Guangxin, and drove Li Xiucheng off.

sentences.zh: 命遇提督缺出侭先題奏。

translations.literal: He was ordered that whenever a provincial military commander's vacancy opened, he was to be recommended first in memorial.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to be the first recommended whenever a provincial military commander's post fell vacant.

sentences.zh: 規取青陽，敗援賊，盡毀城外賊壘。

translations.literal: He planned to take Qingyang, defeated the relieving rebels, and destroyed all the rebel stockades outside the walls.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to take Qingyang, defeated the relieving rebels, and destroyed every rebel work outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，詔推恩諸將，嘉超屢著戰功，賜黃馬褂，授浙江提督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi an edict extended grace to the generals; Chao was praised for repeated battle achievements, granted the yellow riding jacket, and appointed provincial military commander of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi the throne extended honors to the generals. Bao Chao, praised for repeated victories, was granted the yellow riding jacket and appointed provincial military commander of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時賊聚皖南，東連蘇、浙，西瀕江，上自建德、東流，下至銅陵、蕪湖。

translations.literal: At the time the rebels were massed in southern Anhui, linked in the east with Jiangsu and Zhejiang, bordering the river in the west, from Jiande and Dongliu above down to Tongling and Wuhu below.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels were then massed in southern Anhui, linked eastward with Jiangsu and Zhejiang and westward along the river from Jiande and Dongliu down to Tongling and Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 超東西策應，解銅陵圍，克青陽、石埭、太平、涇縣，大破楊輔清於寧國，復其城，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Chao responded in both directions east and west, lifted the siege of Tongling, captured Qingyang, Shidi, Taiping, and Jingxian, inflicted a great defeat on Yang Fuqing at Ningguo and recovered the city, and was granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao maneuvered east and west in support, lifted the siege of Tongling, took Qingyang, Shidi, Taiping, and Jingxian, routed Yang Fuqing at Ningguo and recovered the city, and was granted the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 賊首洪容海、張遇春先後投誠，受降，編其眾為啟化營、春字營，從戰皆有功。

translations.literal: The rebel chiefs Hong Ronghai and Zhang Yuchun successively submitted in good faith; he accepted their surrender, organized their followers into the Qihua Battalion and the Chun-character Battalion, and in following campaigns they all performed merit.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leaders Hong Ronghai and Zhang Yuchun surrendered in turn. Bao Chao accepted them, organized their men into the Qihua Battalion and the Chun-character Battalion, and they served well in the campaigns that followed.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，丁母憂，請終制，詔奪情留軍。

translations.literal: That winter his mother died; he requested to complete the mourning period, but an edict recalled him from mourning and kept him with the army.
translations.idiomatic: That winter his mother died. He asked to observe the full mourning period, but an edict recalled him from mourning and kept him with the army.

sentences.zh: 二年，戰涇縣。

translations.literal: In the second year he fought at Jingxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he fought at Jingxian.

sentences.zh: 賊設伏來誘，超亦潛伏山坳以伺，斷賊後路，夾擊，大破之，遂克西河，灣沚。

translations.literal: The rebels set an ambush to lure him; Chao also lay hidden in a mountain hollow to wait, cut the rebel rear route, struck from both sides, inflicted a great defeat, and then captured Xihe and Wanzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels laid an ambush to draw him in. Bao Chao hid his men in a mountain hollow, cut off their retreat, and struck from both sides, routing them and taking Xihe and Wanzhi.

sentences.zh: 黃文金竄鄱陽，方欲赴援，李秀成又陷江浦、浦口，超馳救，破賊青溪鎮，連克巢縣、含山，和州、江浦、浦口，北岸肅清；

translations.literal: Huang Wenjin fled into Poyang; Chao was just about to go to relieve him when Li Xiucheng again captured Jiangpu and Pukou; Chao raced to the rescue, defeated the rebels at Qingxizhen, and in succession captured Chaoxian and Hanshan, Hexian, Jiangpu, and Pukou, clearing the north bank;
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenjin fled into Poyang, and Bao Chao was preparing to move against him when Li Xiucheng again took Jiangpu and Pukou. Bao Chao raced to the rescue, broke the rebels at Qingxizhen, and in succession took Chaoxian, Hanshan, Hexian, Jiangpu, and Pukou, clearing the north bank;

sentences.zh: 遂會水師克九洑洲，而青陽又被圍，馳至，賊遁，追破之於曹塘，進攻東壩賊巢，克之。

translations.literal: He then joined the river fleet in capturing Jiufuzhou, but Qingyang was besieged again; he raced there, the rebels fled, he pursued and defeated them at Caotang, advanced to attack the rebel nest at Dongba, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the river fleet in taking Jiufuzhou. Qingyang came under siege again, and he raced there as the rebels fled. He pursued, broke them at Caotang, advanced on the rebel stronghold at Dongba, and took it.

sentences.zh: 賊酋先後率眾降者數万，建平、溧水皆复。

translations.literal: Rebel chiefs successively led tens of thousands in surrender; Jianping and Lishui were both recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel leaders surrendered in waves with tens of thousands of followers, and Jianping and Lishui were both recovered.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓奏以東壩為重隘，令超駐守，以備游擊。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan memorialized that Dongba was a critical pass and ordered Chao to garrison it for mobile operations.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan reported that Dongba was a critical pass and ordered Bao Chao to hold it as a base for mobile operations.

sentences.zh: 三年春，克句容、金壇。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he captured Jurong and Jintan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he took Jurong and Jintan.

sentences.zh: 時蘇、浙敗賊聚於江西，命超馳援，破賊於豐城。

translations.literal: At the time defeated rebels from Jiangsu and Zhejiang were massed in Jiangxi; he was ordered to race to their relief and defeated the rebels at Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Defeated rebels from Jiangsu and Zhejiang were then massed in Jiangxi, and Bao Chao was ordered to their relief. He broke them at Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 會江寧克復，論功，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Jiangning was recovered, merit was assessed and he was granted the hereditary office of first-class Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangning was recovered, his merits were assessed and he was granted the hereditary office of first-class Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 七月，破許灣賊巢，連克崇仁、宜黃、東鄉、奎谿、南豐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he broke the rebel nest at Xuwan and in succession captured Chongren, Yihuang, Dongxiang, Kuixi, and Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he stormed the rebel stronghold at Xuwan and in succession took Chongren, Yihuang, Dongxiang, Kuixi, and Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 賊酋陳炳文以六萬人降，受之。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Chen Bingwen surrendered with sixty thousand men, and he accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Chen Bingwen surrendered with sixty thousand men, and Bao Chao accepted them.

sentences.zh: 追賊贛南，解寧都圍，殲賊萬計，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: He pursued the rebels into southern Gan, lifted the siege of Ningdu, destroyed rebels numbering in the tens of thousands, and was granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the rebels into southern Gan, lifted the siege of Ningdu, killed rebels by the tens of thousands, and was awarded the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 賊酋汪海洋遣黨詐降，整軍以待，驟擊之，潰，入瑞金，城下屍積為阜，城賊亦遁，追至福建境。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Wang Haiyang sent partisans to feign surrender; Chao kept his army in order to await them, then suddenly struck; they collapsed; he entered Ruijin, where corpses below the walls piled into mounds; the rebels in the city also fled, and he pursued to the border of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Wang Haiyang sent men to feign surrender. Bao Chao kept his army ready, then struck suddenly. The rebels broke and fled into Ruijin, where corpses heaped below the walls like embankments. The garrison fled as well, and he pursued them to the Fujian border.

sentences.zh: 洪秀全幼子福瑱為贛軍所擒，詔錫封超一等子爵。

translations.literal: Hong Xiuquan's young son Fuzhen was captured by the Gan army; an edict ennobled Chao as a first-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Xiuquan's young son Fuzhen was captured by the Jiangxi army, and an edict ennobled Bao Chao as a first-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 先是，超請回籍葬親，賜銀五百兩，命俟江、皖肅清後予假。

translations.literal: Earlier Chao had requested to return home to bury his parent; five hundred taels of silver were granted, and he was ordered to receive leave after Jiangxi and Anhui were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Bao Chao had asked to return home to bury his parent. The throne granted five hundred taels of silver and ordered that leave be given once Jiangxi and Anhui were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，申前請，允之，復命假滿率舊部出關援新疆。

translations.literal: That winter he renewed his earlier request and it was granted; he was also ordered that when his leave ended he was to lead his old troops beyond the pass to relieve Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he renewed his request and it was granted. He was also ordered that when his mourning leave ended he was to lead his old troops west to relieve Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 所部多南人，畏遠征，疆臣多以為言，請留剿粵匪餘孽，曾國籓亦請先留甘肅內地。

translations.literal: Most of his troops were southerners and feared a distant campaign; frontier officials repeatedly spoke on the matter and requested that he remain to suppress the remaining Cantonese rebels; Zeng Guofan also requested that he first be kept in the interior of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Most of his men were southerners and dreaded a distant expedition. Frontier officials repeatedly petitioned that he be kept to suppress the remaining Cantonese rebels, and Zeng Guofan also asked that he be held first in the interior of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 超已令部將宋國永率八千人先發，四年春，至湖北金口，軍潰。

translations.literal: Chao had already ordered his subordinate general Song Guoyong to lead eight thousand men to set out first; in the spring of the fourth year they reached Jinkou in Hubei and the army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao had already sent his lieutenant Song Guoyong ahead with eight thousand men. In the spring of the fourth year they reached Jinkou in Hubei, and the army broke up.

sentences.zh: 詔急起超於家，免其出關，改赴福建，命沿途招撫潰勇。

translations.literal: An edict urgently recalled Chao from home, exempted him from going beyond the pass, changed his destination to Fujian, and ordered him to recruit and pacify scattered troops along the way.
translations.idiomatic: An edict urgently recalled Bao Chao from home, exempted him from the Xinjiang expedition, and redirected him to Fujian with orders to gather and pacify scattered troops along the route.

sentences.zh: 潰勇多降眾，仍由江西趨粵與匪合，超由贛州進剿。

translations.literal: Many of the scattered troops were surrendered followers; they still went by way of Jiangxi toward Guangdong to join the rebels; Chao advanced to suppress them from Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Many of the scattered troops were surrendered rebels. They still moved through Jiangxi toward Guangdong to rejoin the insurgents, and Bao Chao advanced against them from Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪餘黨聚踞嘉應州，汪海洋已為閩軍所殲，賊中推譚體元為首。

translations.literal: At the time the remaining Cantonese rebels were massed at Jiaying Prefecture; Wang Haiyang had already been destroyed by the Fujian army, and the rebels chose Tan Tiyuan as their leader.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining Cantonese rebels were then massed at Jiaying Prefecture. Wang Haiyang had already been destroyed by the Fujian army, and the rebels raised Tan Tiyuan as their leader.

sentences.zh: 十二月，戰於平成鋪，賊踞嶺而陣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he fought at Pingchengpu; the rebels held the ridge and formed battle lines.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he fought at Pingchengpu, where the rebels held the ridge in battle formation.

sentences.zh: 超合閩、粵諸軍大破之，追至城下，宵遁。

translations.literal: Chao together with the Fujian and Guangdong armies inflicted a great defeat on them, pursued to the foot of the city walls, and the rebels fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao joined the Fujian and Guangdong armies in a great victory, pursued the rebels to the city walls, and drove them to flee by night.

sentences.zh: 預設伏於黃沙障及北溪、白沙壩，五路兜擊，譚體元中槍墜崖死，諸酋擒斬無漏網者，獲叛勇歐陽輝、黃矮子等磔之。

translations.literal: He had beforehand set ambushes at Huangshazhang, Beixi, and Baishaba; five routes closed in on them; Tan Tiyuan was struck by a bullet, fell from a cliff, and died; all the chiefs were captured and executed without any escaping the net; the rebel troops Ouyang Hui, Huang Aizi, and others were taken and dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: He had already set ambushes at Huangshazhang, Beixi, and Baishaba, and five columns closed in on the rebels. Tan Tiyuan was shot, fell from a cliff, and died. Every rebel chief was captured or killed, none escaping the net. The turncoat soldiers Ouyang Hui, Huang Aizi, and others were taken and executed by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 粵匪蕩平，加一云騎尉世職。

translations.literal: The Cantonese rebels were thoroughly pacified, and he was given an additional hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: With the Cantonese rebels thoroughly suppressed, he was granted an additional hereditary Cloud Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 五年，仍授浙江提督，命移師剿捻，追逐於湖北、河南、陝西界上，賊望風輒走。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was again appointed provincial military commander of Zhejiang, ordered to shift his army to suppress the Nian bandits, pursued them on the borders of Hubei, Henan, and Shaanxi, and the rebels fled at the first sign of his approach.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was again appointed provincial military commander of Zhejiang and ordered to turn his army against the Nian bandits. He chased them along the borders of Hubei, Henan, and Shaanxi, and the rebels fled at the mere sight of his banners.

sentences.zh: 疆臣爭欲得其兵為助，以西安戒嚴，詔飭赴陝。

translations.literal: Frontier officials all competed to obtain his troops as assistance, but because Xi'an was under martial law an edict ordered him to hurry to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials all vied for his troops as reinforcements, but with Xi'an under martial alert an edict ordered him to march to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，抵樊城，聞捻匪至，與淮軍將劉銘傳約期於安陸永隆河夾擊。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year he reached Fancheng, heard that Nian bandits had arrived, and arranged with Huai Army general Liu Mingchuan to strike them from both sides at Yonglonghe in Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year he reached Fancheng, learned that Nian bandits were approaching, and arranged with Huai Army general Liu Mingchuan for a pincer attack at Yonglonghe in Anlu.

sentences.zh: 銘傳先至，為賊所敗，夷傷頗重。

translations.literal: Mingchuan arrived first, was defeated by the rebels, and killed and wounded were quite heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Mingchuan arrived first and was beaten by the rebels, with heavy casualties.

sentences.zh: 超至，擊賊背，大破之。

translations.literal: Chao arrived, struck the rebels' rear, and inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao arrived, struck the rebels from the rear, and routed them utterly.

sentences.zh: 任柱、賴文光遁走，俘其妻孥，奪回所失軍裝。

translations.literal: Ren Zhu and Lai Wenguang fled; their wives and children were captured, and the lost military equipment was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zhu and Lai Wenguang fled. Their families were taken prisoner, and the lost military equipment was recovered.

sentences.zh: 超久為名將，銘傳後起與之埒。

translations.literal: Chao had long been a famous general; Mingchuan rose later and was his equal.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao had long been a renowned commander, but Mingchuan had risen later to match him.

sentences.zh: 是役超自以轉敗為勝有功，而銘傳咎其後至，李鴻章右銘傳，超大憤，稱病。

translations.literal: In this battle Chao considered himself meritorious for turning defeat into victory, but Mingchuan blamed him for arriving late; Li Hongzhang favored Mingchuan; Chao was greatly angered and claimed illness.
translations.idiomatic: In this battle Bao Chao believed he deserved credit for snatching victory from defeat, but Mingchuan blamed him for arriving late. Li Hongzhang sided with Mingchuan, and Bao Chao, furious, pleaded illness.

sentences.zh: 迭詔慰勉，曾國籓及鴻章馳書相繼。

translations.literal: Edicts repeatedly comforted and encouraged him; Zeng Guofan and Hongzhang sent letters in quick succession.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated edicts sought to comfort and encourage him, and Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang sent letters one after another.

sentences.zh: 超終乞罷去軍，所部三十營，令部將宋國永、唐仁廉分領。

translations.literal: Chao finally begged to leave the army; his thirty battalions were ordered divided between his subordinate generals Song Guoyong and Tang Renlian.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao finally begged to leave the army. His thirty battalions were placed under his lieutenants Song Guoyong and Tang Renlian.

sentences.zh: 詔婁雲慶代將，皆慮其軍難制，遣散過半焉。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Lou Yunqing to replace him as commander; all feared the army was hard to control, and more than half were disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Lou Yunqing to take command, but everyone feared the army would prove unruly, and more than half the men were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 超既歸，屢敕問病狀。

translations.literal: After Chao had returned home, repeated edicts inquired after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: After Bao Chao returned home, the throne repeatedly sent edicts inquiring after his health.

sentences.zh: 十三年，召來京，因病未復，仍續假。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was summoned to the capital; because his illness had not recovered, leave was extended.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was summoned to the capital, but because he had not recovered from illness his leave was extended.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，起授湖南提督，募軍駐樂亭防俄羅斯，事定回任。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he was recalled and appointed provincial military commander of Hunan, raised troops and stationed them at Leting against Russia, and after matters were settled returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Guangxu he was recalled and appointed provincial military commander of Hunan. He raised troops and posted them at Leting to guard against Russia; when the crisis passed he returned to duty.

sentences.zh: 八年，復以病請解職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again requested resignation on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he again asked to resign on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十一年，法越戰起，命率師駐雲南馬白關外。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Franco-Vietnamese war broke out; he was ordered to lead troops and station them outside Mabai Pass in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Franco-Vietnamese war broke out, and he was ordered to lead his troops to camp outside Mabai Pass in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 和議成，撤防回籍。

translations.literal: When peace was concluded, the garrison was withdrawn and he returned to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: Once peace was concluded, the garrison was withdrawn and he returned home.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒，贈太子少保，賜銀三千兩治喪，立功地建專祠，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died; he was posthumously given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted three thousand taels of silver for funeral expenses, a dedicated shrine was built at the place of his merit, and he was given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died. He was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted three thousand taels of silver for his funeral, given a dedicated shrine at the site of his victories, and honored with the posthumous name Zhongzhuang, Loyal and Magnificent.

sentences.zh: 子祖齡襲爵，官浙江金衢嚴道。

translations.literal: His son Zuling inherited the title and served as intendant of the Jin-Qu-Yan Circuit in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zuling inherited the title and served as intendant of the Jin-Qu-Yan Circuit in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 超治軍信賞必罰，不事苛細，得士卒死力。

translations.literal: Chao governed the army with faithful rewards and punishments, did not trouble himself with petty details, and won the troops' utmost devotion.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao governed his army with unwavering reward and punishment, spared no petty meddling, and won his men's utter devotion.

sentences.zh: 進戰，疾如風雨，賊望而披靡，棄械跪馬前，即不殺，以此服其威信。

translations.literal: Advancing to battle he was swift as wind and rain; rebels crumbled at the sight of him; those who cast aside weapons and knelt before his horse were not killed, and by this they submitted to his authority and prestige.
translations.idiomatic: In attack he moved like wind and rain. Rebels broke at the sight of him, and those who cast down their weapons and knelt before his horse were spared. In this way they came to fear his authority and prestige.

sentences.zh: 所部多驍將，宋國永、婁雲慶最為所倚。

translations.literal: His command had many fierce generals; Song Guoyong and Lou Yunqing were those he relied on most.
translations.idiomatic: His command boasted many fierce generals, above all Song Guoyong and Lou Yunqing, on whom he relied most heavily.

sentences.zh: 譚勝達、唐仁廉亦並至專閫。

translations.literal: Tan Shengda and Tang Renlian also both reached sole provincial command.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shengda and Tang Renlian likewise rose to independent provincial command.

sentences.zh: 國永，四川人。

translations.literal: Guoyong was a native of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Song Guoyong was a native of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 由軍功補千總。

translations.literal: Through military merit he received appointment as company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He earned appointment as company commander through military merit.

sentences.zh: 初從鮑超隸水師，以戰金口功，擢守備。

translations.literal: At first he followed Bao Chao in the river fleet; for merit in the battle at Jinkou he was promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first served under Bao Chao in the river fleet and, for his part in the battle at Jinkou, was promoted to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 破賊童司牌、黃蠟山，克麻城、黃安，累擢參將。

translations.literal: He defeated rebels at Tongshipai and Huanglashan, captured Macheng and Huang'an, and through repeated promotions rose to brigade vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: He broke the rebels at Tongshipai and Huanglashan, took Macheng and Huang'an, and was repeatedly promoted until he reached brigade vice commander.

sentences.zh: 霆軍初立，為營官。

translations.literal: When the Ting Army was first established, he became a battalion officer.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ting Army was first formed, he served as a battalion officer.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，曾國籓調霆軍赴皖南。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan transferred the Ting Army to southern Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, Zeng Guofan transferred the Ting Army to southern Anhui.

sentences.zh: 鮑超方假歸，國永暫統其軍。

translations.literal: Bao Chao was then on leave at home, and Guoyong temporarily commanded his army.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao was then on leave, and Song Guoyong temporarily took command of his army.

sentences.zh: 及超至，從攻休寧，分兵复黟縣，連破賊於羊棧嶺、盧村、洋塘、黃麥鋪，功皆最，超擢以總兵記名。

translations.literal: When Chao arrived, he joined the assault on Xiuning, divided troops to recover Yi County, and in succession defeated rebels at Yangzhanling, Lucun, Yangtang, and Huangmaipu; his merit was rated foremost each time, and Chao had him registered for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Bao Chao arrived, Song Guoyong joined the attack on Xiuning, sent detachments to recover Yi County, and in succession broke the rebels at Yangzhanling, Lucun, Yangtang, and Huangmaipu. Each time his merit was rated highest, and Bao Chao had him registered for appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，補廣西梧州協副將。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he received the substantive post of assistant brigade deputy of the Wuzhou Garrison in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed assistant brigade deputy of the Wuzhou Garrison in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 從援江西，破賊樟樹鎮，加提督銜。

translations.literal: He joined the relief of Jiangxi, defeated rebels at Zhangshuzhen, and was given the rank of provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the relief of Jiangxi, broke the rebels at Zhangshuzhen, and was granted the rank of provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 克鉛山，解撫州、廣信圍，以提督記名。

translations.literal: He captured Qianshan, lifted the sieges of Fuzhou and Guangxin, and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: He took Qianshan, lifted the sieges of Fuzhou and Guangxin, and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克青陽、寧國，授直隸宣化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Qingyang and Ningguo and was appointed regional commander of Xuanhua Garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Qingyang and Ningguo and was appointed regional commander of Xuanhua Garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 時楊輔清仍踞寧國附近圖返攻，國永屯老祖山，迭​​破來犯之賊。

translations.literal: At the time Yang Fuqing still held positions near Ningguo and plotted a counterattack; Guoyong encamped at Laozushan and repeatedly defeated attacking rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fuqing still held ground near Ningguo and plotted a counterattack. Song Guoyong encamped at Laozushan and repeatedly repulsed the rebels who came against him.

sentences.zh: 二年，進克西河、灣沚，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the second year he advanced and captured Xihe and Wanzhi and was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he advanced and took Xihe and Wanzhi, and was granted the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 三年，江南平，鮑超回籍，國永與婁雲慶分領其軍，調赴福建，未行。

translations.literal: In the third year the Jiangnan region was pacified; Bao Chao returned to his native place; Guoyong and Lou Yunqing divided command of his army; they were transferred to Fujian but did not depart.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, with Jiangnan pacified, Bao Chao returned home and Song Guoyong and Lou Yunqing divided command of his army. Orders came to transfer them to Fujian, but they had not yet marched.

sentences.zh: 四年，鮑超將赴新疆，國永率所部由江西先發，軍中索餉鼓譟，撫定之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Bao Chao was about to go to Xinjiang; Guoyong led his own troops out first through Jiangxi; the army clamored for pay in mutiny, and he pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, as Bao Chao prepared to march to Xinjiang, Song Guoyong led his troops out first through Jiangxi. The men mutinied demanding pay, and he restored order.

sentences.zh: 道經湖北，复譁潰於金口。

translations.literal: Passing through Hubei, they again mutinied and broke at Jinkou.
translations.idiomatic: On the march through Hubei they mutinied again and broke at Jinkou.

sentences.zh: 坐不能約束，褫職留營。

translations.literal: Because he could not maintain discipline, his office was stripped but he remained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for failing to maintain discipline, he was stripped of rank but kept with the army.

sentences.zh: 從克嘉應州，復原官。

translations.literal: He joined in capturing Jiaying Prefecture and was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in capturing Jiaying Prefecture and was restored to his former rank.

sentences.zh: 從剿捻匪，自永隆河破賊後，鮑超乞病，軍中事一倚國永。

translations.literal: He joined in suppressing the Nian bandits; after the victory over the rebels at Yonglonghe, Bao Chao pleaded illness, and all army affairs depended solely on Guoyong.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against the Nian bandits, and after the victory at Yonglonghe Bao Chao pleaded illness and left all army affairs to Song Guoyong alone.

sentences.zh: 及超去軍，國永先請散遣己所部眾，餘付婁雲慶統之。

translations.literal: When Chao left the army, Guoyong first requested to disband the troops under his own command and turned the remainder over to Lou Yunqing to command.
translations.idiomatic: When Bao Chao left the army, Song Guoyong first asked to disband the men under his own command and handed the rest over to Lou Yunqing.

sentences.zh: 八年，授雲南鶴麗鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed regional commander of Heli Garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed regional commander of Heli Garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章疏陳國永戰績，稱為膽識兼優、不可多得之才。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang memorialized detailing Guoyong's battle achievements and called him a man of combined courage and judgment, a talent hard to find.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang memorialized Song Guoyong's battle record and praised him as a man of courage and judgment alike, a talent rarely found.

sentences.zh: 留於兩江委用，駐防鎮江。

translations.literal: He was retained for employment in the Two Jiangs region and garrisoned at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was kept for service in the Two Jiangs region and posted at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，調赴福建。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu he was transferred to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu reign he was transferred to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒，詔念前功，允祀四川、湖北霆軍昭忠祠。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died; an edict recalled his earlier merit and permitted sacrifice at the Loyalty Martyrs Shrines of the Ting Army in Sichuan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died. An edict recalled his earlier service and permitted his spirit tablet to be enshrined in the Ting Army Loyalty Martyrs Shrines in Sichuan and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 雲慶，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: Yunqing was a native of Changsha, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Yunqing was a native of Changsha, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 初入水師，累功至都司，尋充霆軍營官。

translations.literal: He first entered the river fleet, rose through accumulated merit to colonel, and soon served as a battalion officer in the Ting Army.
translations.idiomatic: He first joined the river fleet, rose through repeated merit to colonel, and soon became a battalion officer in the Ting Army.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，小池驛之戰，功最，擢參將。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, in the battle at Xiaochiyi, his merit was rated foremost and he was promoted to brigade vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, at the battle of Xiaochiyi, his merit was rated highest and he was promoted to brigade vice commander.

sentences.zh: 從戰皖南，會鮑超赴援江西，留雲慶率四營扼漁亭。

translations.literal: He fought in southern Anhui; when Bao Chao went to relieve Jiangxi, Yunqing was left with four battalions to hold Yuting.
translations.idiomatic: He fought in southern Anhui. When Bao Chao marched to relieve Jiangxi, Lou Yunqing was left with four battalions to hold Yuting.

sentences.zh: 賊聞大軍遠出，突來犯，擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels heard that the main army had marched far away and suddenly came to attack; he struck and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that the main army had marched far off, the rebels suddenly attacked, but he beat them back.

sentences.zh: 追至岩勍，斃賊酋黃世瑚等，复擊敗上溪口賊。

translations.literal: He pursued to Yanqing, killed the rebel chiefs Huang Shihu and others, and again defeated the rebels at Shangxikou.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued them to Yanqing, killed the rebel chiefs Huang Shihu and others, and then defeated the rebels at Shangxikou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，會克休寧。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined in capturing Xiuning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined in capturing Xiuning.

sentences.zh: 既而攻徽州，諸軍失利，雲慶仍挫賊，全軍而退。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they attacked Huizhou; the various armies met defeat, but Yunqing still repulsed the rebels and withdrew the whole force intact.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward they attacked Huizhou. The allied armies were beaten, but Lou Yunqing still checked the rebels and withdrew his whole force intact.

sentences.zh: 尋會張運蘭戰盧村，遂克徽州，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Zhang Yunlan in fighting at Lucun, then captured Huizhou, and was registered for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He soon joined Zhang Yunlan in battle at Lucun and captured Huizhou, and was registered for appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 從鮑超轉戰江西，數破賊，功最，授直隸正定鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Following Bao Chao he campaigned back and forth in Jiangxi, repeatedly defeated rebels, his merit was rated foremost, and he was appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning with Bao Chao across Jiangxi, he repeatedly broke the rebels, his merit was rated highest, and he was appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從克青陽，乘勝攻石埭，雲慶率士卒負板薄城，蟻附而登，克之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he joined in capturing Qingyang, pressed the victory to attack Shicheng, Yunqing led troops carrying boards close to the wall, scaled it like ants climbing, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he helped take Qingyang and, pressing the victory, attacked Shicheng. Lou Yunqing led his men up to the walls under shield boards, swarmed over them like ants, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 時霆軍威名益著，營隊日增。

translations.literal: At the time the Ting Army's fame grew ever greater, and its battalions increased day by day.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Ting Army's renown was ever greater, and its battalions grew daily.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓令雲慶與宋國永為其軍分統，克寧國，以提督記名，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan ordered Yunqing and Song Guoyong to divide command of the army, captured Ningguo, registered Yunqing for appointment as provincial military commander, and granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan put Lou Yunqing and Song Guoyong in joint command of the army. They captured Ningguo, Lou Yunqing was registered for appointment as provincial military commander, and he was granted the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 三年，分兵克金壇。

translations.literal: In the third year he divided troops and captured Jintan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he sent detachments and captured Jintan.

sentences.zh: 及江寧既下，調援江西。

translations.literal: After Jiangning had fallen, he was transferred to relieve Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiangning fell, he was transferred to relieve Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 既而鮑超奉命西征，分兵令宋國永赴陝甘，雲慶率萬人援福建。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Bao Chao was ordered on a western campaign; troops were divided and Song Guoyong was sent to Shaanxi and Gansu, while Yunqing led ten thousand men to relieve Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Bao Chao was ordered west. Troops were divided: Song Guoyong was sent to Shaanxi and Gansu, while Lou Yunqing led ten thousand men to reinforce Fujian.

sentences.zh: 國永軍再譁潰，雲慶軍不遠役，又得餉，未為搖動。

translations.literal: Guoyong's army mutinied and broke again; Yunqing's army was not sent on distant service, also received pay, and was not shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Song Guoyong's army mutinied and broke again, but Lou Yunqing's men were not sent on distant service, received their pay, and held firm.

sentences.zh: 尋從鮑超滅賊於嘉應，始赴正定鎮本任。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Bao Chao in destroying the rebels at Jiaying and only then went to take up his substantive post at Zhengding Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Bao Chao in wiping out the rebels at Jiaying and only then took up his substantive post at Zhengding Garrison.

sentences.zh: 六年，鮑超病歸，眾慮霆軍難制，曾國籓薦雲慶才能應變，詔飭接統。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Bao Chao returned home ill; all feared the Ting Army would be hard to control; Zeng Guofan recommended Yunqing's talent for meeting emergencies; an edict ordered him to take over command.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Bao Chao went home ill. Everyone feared the Ting Army would prove unruly, but Zeng Guofan recommended Lou Yunqing for his resourcefulness, and an edict ordered him to take command.

sentences.zh: 遂裁撤全軍，改募五千人，號曰霆峻營，駐防湖北。

translations.literal: He then disbanded the whole army, recruited five thousand men anew, called them the Ting Jun battalions, and garrisoned them in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He then disbanded the whole force, recruited five thousand fresh troops under the name Ting Jun battalions, and posted them in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 明年，捻平，雲慶請歸養。

translations.literal: The next year the Nian were pacified, and Yunqing requested leave to return home and care for his parents.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, with the Nian suppressed, Lou Yunqing asked to retire and care for his parents.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，復起授正定鎮總兵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu he was recalled and again appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu reign he was recalled and again appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison.

sentences.zh: 十七年，擢湖南提督。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以老乞歸，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, pleading old age, he requested to return home and died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he asked to retire on account of age, returned home, and died there.

sentences.zh: 勝達，湖南長沙人。

translations.literal: Shengda was a native of Changsha, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shengda was a native of Changsha, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，投效霆軍，無役不從。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng era he entered the Ting Army's service and was absent from no campaign.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era he joined the Ting Army and fought in every campaign.

sentences.zh: 石牌、羊棧嶺、洋塘、赤岡嶺諸戰，功皆最，累擢至副將。

translations.literal: At Shipai, Yangzhanling, Yangtang, Chigangling, and other battles his merit was rated foremost each time, and through repeated promotions he rose to brigade deputy.
translations.idiomatic: At Shipai, Yangzhanling, Yangtang, Chigangling, and other battles his merit was rated highest each time, and he rose through repeated promotion to brigade deputy.

sentences.zh: 從戰雙港，克鉛山，賜號協勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He joined battle at Shuanggang, captured Qianshan, and was granted the title Xieyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He fought at Shuanggang, captured Qianshan, and was granted the honorific title Xieyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，赴援銅陵，戰橫塘，斬賊酋於陣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he went to relieve Tongling, fought at Hengtang, and beheaded a rebel chief in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he marched to relieve Tongling, fought at Hengtang, and killed a rebel chief in the field.

sentences.zh: 進攻城外賊壘，勝達偕唐仁廉冒砲煙逾壕，奪其一壘，餘壘皆下。

translations.literal: Advancing to storm the rebel stockades outside the walls, Shengda together with Tang Renlian braved cannon fire, crossed the moat, seized one stockade, and the rest all fell.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the rebel stockades outside the walls, Tan Shengda and Tang Renlian braved the cannon fire, crossed the moat, took one stockade, and the rest fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 賊夜遁，复銅陵，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: The rebels fled by night; Tongling was recovered, and he was registered for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled by night, Tongling was recovered, and he was registered for appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 又戰於寒亭，勝達橫衝賊隊截為四，不能成伍，大破之，复寧國，加提督銜。

translations.literal: He fought again at Hanting; Shengda charged across the rebel ranks and cut them into four sections so they could not form ranks; he inflicted a great defeat, recovered Ningguo, and was given the rank of provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again at Hanting. Tan Shengda charged through the rebel ranks, cut them into four scattered groups, and routed them utterly. Ningguo was recovered, and he was granted the rank of provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 二年，分兵解涇縣圍，連奪西河、灣沚要隘，詔遇總兵缺先行簡放。

translations.literal: In the second year he divided troops to lift the siege of Jing County, in succession seized the strategic passes at Xihe and Wanzhi, and an edict ordered that when a regional commander's post fell vacant he should be appointed first.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he sent detachments to lift the siege of Jing County and in succession seized the strategic passes at Xihe and Wanzhi. An edict directed that whenever a regional commander's post opened, he should be appointed first.

sentences.zh: 三年，克句容，以提督記名。

translations.literal: In the third year he captured Jurong and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he captured Jurong and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 鮑超以東壩為重隘，令勝達守之。

translations.literal: Bao Chao considered Dongba a critical pass and ordered Shengda to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao considered Dongba a critical pass and ordered Tan Shengda to hold it.

sentences.zh: 賊至，蔽山谷。

translations.literal: When the rebels arrived, they filled the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels came, they filled the valleys.

sentences.zh: 勝達陷陣，刺殺其酋，賊大潰。

translations.literal: Shengda plunged into the enemy lines, stabbed and killed their chief, and the rebels broke in great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Shengda plunged into the enemy lines, killed their chief, and the rebels broke in utter rout.

sentences.zh: 踐屍追擊，殲斃數千。

translations.literal: Treading on corpses he pursued and killed several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued over the dead, killing several thousand.

sentences.zh: 尋赴援江西，克新城，解寧都圍。

translations.literal: Soon he went to relieve Jiangxi, captured Xincheng, and lifted the siege of Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon marched to relieve Jiangxi, captured Xincheng, and lifted the siege of Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 四年，霆軍以索餉毆傷糧道段起，勝達坐褫職，尋復之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Ting Army, demanding pay, beat and wounded grain transport official Duan Qi; Shengda was punished by stripping of office, but soon was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Ting Army, demanding pay, beat and wounded grain transport official Duan Qi. Tan Shengda was stripped of rank for failing to control his men, but was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 及嘉應殄滅粵匪，賜黃馬褂，授直隸正定鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When Jiaying saw the extermination of the Cantonese rebels, he was granted the yellow riding jacket and appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: After the Cantonese rebels were destroyed at Jiaying, he was granted the yellow riding jacket and appointed regional commander of Zhengding Garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 八年，始赴任，練軍捕盜，濬河修堤，頗著勞勚。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he finally went to take up his post, drilled troops to capture bandits, dredged rivers and repaired dikes, and achieved considerable meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he finally took up his post, drilled troops against bandits, dredged rivers and repaired dikes, and won considerable distinction.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒於官，賜卹，諡勇愨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died in office; condolence gifts were granted, and he was given the posthumous name Yongque.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he died in office. Condolence gifts were granted, and he was honored with the posthumous name Yongque, Valiant and Sincere.

sentences.zh: 唐仁廉，湖南東安人。

translations.literal: Tang Renlian was a native of Dong'an, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Renlian was a native of Dong'an, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 初隸楊岳斌部下。

translations.literal: At first he served under Yang Yuebin.
translations.idiomatic: He first served under Yang Yuebin.

sentences.zh: 粵匪韋志俊以池州降，仁廉從彭玉麟往受之。

translations.literal: The Cantonese rebel Wei Zhijun surrendered Chizhou; Renlian followed Peng Yulin to receive the surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When the Cantonese rebel Wei Zhijun surrendered Chizhou, Tang Renlian went with Peng Yulin to accept the surrender.

sentences.zh: 賊黨忽變，仁廉手刃其悍者數人，岳斌嘉其勇，令選降眾立仁字營。

translations.literal: The rebel party suddenly turned on them; Renlian personally killed several of their fiercest men with his blade; Yuebin praised his courage and ordered selected surrendered troops formed into the Ren-character battalion.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel party suddenly turned on them. Tang Renlian personally cut down several of their fiercest men. Yang Yuebin praised his courage and had selected surrendered troops formed into the Ren-character battalion under his command.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，改隸霆軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was transferred to the Ting Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was transferred to the Ting Army.

sentences.zh: 從戰太平、石埭間，擢守備。

translations.literal: He fought between Taiping and Shicheng and was promoted to garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: He fought between Taiping and Shicheng and was promoted to garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 克黟縣、建德，擢游擊，賜號壯勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: He captured Yi County and Jiande, was promoted to mobile corps commander, and was granted the title Zhuangyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Yi County and Jiande, was promoted to mobile corps commander, and was granted the honorific title Zhuangyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 破安慶援賊於赤岡嶺，戰豐城，克鉛山，累擢副將。

translations.literal: He defeated Anqing relief rebels at Chigangling, fought at Fengcheng, captured Qianshan, and through repeated promotions rose to brigade deputy.
translations.idiomatic: He broke the Anqing relief force at Chigangling, fought at Fengcheng, captured Qianshan, and rose through repeated promotion to brigade deputy.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克青陽，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Qingyang and was registered for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Qingyang and was registered for appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，克金壇，以提督記名。

translations.literal: In the third year he captured Jintan and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he captured Jintan and was registered for appointment as provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 四年，戰嘉應，粵匪蕩平，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he fought at Jiaying; the Cantonese rebels were thoroughly pacified, and he was granted the yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he fought at Jiaying. With the Cantonese rebels thoroughly suppressed, he was granted the yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 五年，從剿捻匪，率馬隊逐賊於鄂、豫之交。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he joined in suppressing the Nian bandits, leading cavalry to pursue rebels at the border of Hubei and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he joined the campaign against the Nian bandits, leading his cavalry in pursuit of the rebels along the Hubei-Henan frontier.

sentences.zh: 六年，大破賊於永隆河，連敗之於鍾祥池河、棗陽平林店。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he routed the rebels at Yonglong River and defeated them again at Zhongxiang Chihe and Zaoyang Pinglin Store.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he routed the rebels at Yonglong River and defeated them again at Zhongxiang Chihe and Zaoyang Pinglin Store.

sentences.zh: 鮑超解軍事，仁廉分統其眾，從李鴻章剿匪。

translations.literal: When Bao Chao resigned from military affairs, Renlian shared command of his troops and followed Li Hongzhang in suppressing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Bao Chao stepped down from military command, Tang Renlian took joint charge of his forces and followed Li Hongzhang in suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 東捻平，論功，遇提督侭先簡放。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Nian were pacified, merits were assessed, and upon reaching provincial military commander he was among the first selected for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: After the Eastern Nian were pacified, merits were assessed, and when he reached the rank of provincial military commander he was among the first selected for appointment.

sentences.zh: 西捻張總愚犯畿輔，仁廉追賊於直隸、河南、山東三省之間，連敗之濬縣大伾山、海豐郝家寨、商河李家坊。

translations.literal: The Western Nian leader Zhang Zongyu invaded the capital region; Renlian pursued the rebels between the three provinces of Zhili, Henan, and Shandong, defeating them repeatedly at Dapishan in Jun County, Haojiazhai in Haifeng, and Lijiafang in Shanghe.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Nian leader Zhang Zongyu invaded the capital region, Tang Renlian pursued the rebels across Zhili, Henan, and Shandong, defeating them repeatedly at Dapishan in Jun County, Haojiazhai in Haifeng, and Lijiafang in Shanghe.

sentences.zh: 又偕郭松林合擊於沙河，總愚中槍遁，再敗之於高唐盧寨。

translations.literal: He also joined Guo Songlin in a combined attack at Shahe; Zongyu was hit by gunfire and fled, and they defeated him again at Luzhai in Gaotang.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined Guo Songlin in a combined attack at Shahe. Zhang Zongyu was wounded by gunfire and fled, and they defeated him again at Luzhai in Gaotang.

sentences.zh: 西捻平，以一等軍功議敘。

translations.literal: When the Western Nian were pacified, his merits were assessed at first-class military distinction.
translations.idiomatic: After the Western Nian were pacified, his merits were assessed at first-class military distinction.

sentences.zh: 九年，從李鴻章援陝西，平北山土匪。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Li Hongzhang to relieve Shaanxi and pacified the bandits of Beishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Li Hongzhang to relieve Shaanxi and pacified the bandits of the northern hills.

sentences.zh: 尋調防畿輔，駐青縣馬廠。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to guard the capital region, garrisoned at Machang in Qing County.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to guard the capital region and garrisoned at Machang in Qing County.

sentences.zh: 十三年，授通永鎮總兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed regional commander of Tongyong Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed regional commander of Tongyong Garrison.

sentences.zh: 光緒十年，擢廣東水師提督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Guangxu he was promoted to provincial military commander of the Guangdong naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Guangxu he was promoted to provincial military commander of the Guangdong naval forces.

sentences.zh: 二十年，皇太后萬壽恩，詔加尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, on the occasion of the empress dowager's longevity grace, he was granted by edict the honorary rank of secretary of state.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, on the occasion of the empress dowager's birthday amnesty, an edict granted him the honorary rank of secretary of state.

sentences.zh: 日本犯遼東，時以唐仁廉為霆軍舊將，召至京。

translations.literal: When Japan invaded eastern Liaodong, Tang Renlian, being a veteran general of the Ting Army, was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Japan invaded eastern Liaodong, Tang Renlian, as a veteran general of the Ting Army, was summoned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 仁廉奮發陳方略，請募二十營當前敵，允之。

translations.literal: Renlian spoke with vigor setting forth strategy and requested to recruit twenty battalions to face the enemy front; his request was approved.
