translations.idiomatic: Tang Renlian spoke with vigor, setting forth his strategy and requesting permission to recruit twenty battalions to meet the enemy at the front. His request was approved.

sentences.zh: 及成軍出關，和議旋定，遂還。

translations.literal: When the army was formed and marched out through the pass, peace talks were soon settled, and he then returned.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the army was formed and marched out through the pass, peace talks had been settled, and he returned.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died; condolence gifts were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he died. Condolence gifts were granted.

sentences.zh: 劉松山，字壽卿，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: Liu Songshan, style Shouqing, was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan, style Shouqing, was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan.

sentences.zh: 初應募入湘營，隸王珍部下，從平永州、郴、株諸匪，以功擢千總。

translations.literal: At first he enlisted in the Hunan camp, served under Wang Zhen, helped pacify the rebels of Yongzhou, Chen, and Zhuzhou, and for merit was promoted to platoon commander.
translations.idiomatic: He first enlisted in the Hunan camp and served under Wang Zhen, helping to pacify the rebels of Yongzhou, Chen, and Zhuzhou. For his merit he was promoted to platoon commander.

sentences.zh: 咸豐七年，克崇陽、通山，擢守備，始領一營。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xianfeng he captured Chongyang and Tongshan, was promoted to garrison commander, and first came to command a battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xianfeng he captured Chongyang and Tongshan, was promoted to garrison commander, and for the first time took command of a battalion.

sentences.zh: 從援江西，克廣昌、樂安，擢都司。

translations.literal: He went to relieve Jiangxi, captured Guangchang and Le'an, and was promoted to battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: He marched to relieve Jiangxi, captured Guangchang and Le'an, and was promoted to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 王珍卒，張運蘭分領其軍。

translations.literal: When Wang Zhen died, Zhang Yunlan took divided command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Zhen died, Zhang Yunlan took divided command of his army.

sentences.zh: 松山從戰克建昌，擢游擊。

translations.literal: Songshan fought and captured Jianchang, and was promoted to mobile corps commander.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan fought and captured Jianchang and was promoted to mobile corps commander.

sentences.zh: 賊由福建回竄江西，陷安仁。

translations.literal: The rebels doubled back from Fujian into Jiangxi and captured Anren.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels doubled back from Fujian into Jiangxi and captured Anren.

sentences.zh: 松山從破賊於青山鋪，進攻安仁，攀堞先登，克之，擢參將。

translations.literal: Songshan helped defeat the rebels at Qingshanpu, advanced to attack Anren, scaled the ramparts first to reach the top, captured it, and was promoted to colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan helped defeat the rebels at Qingshanpu, advanced to attack Anren, was first to scale the ramparts and reach the top, captured the city, and was promoted to colonel.

sentences.zh: 會剿廣東連州踞賊，擒其酋，折回江西。

translations.literal: He joined in suppressing the rebels entrenched at Lianzhou in Guangdong, captured their chieftain, and returned to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He joined in suppressing the entrenched rebels at Lianzhou in Guangdong, captured their chieftain, and returned to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九年，轉戰至徽州，屯祁門。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he fought his way to Huizhou and encamped at Qimen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he fought his way to Huizhou and encamped at Qimen.

sentences.zh: 賊自盧村來犯，突擊敗之。

translations.literal: Rebels came from Lucun to attack; he struck suddenly and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels came from Lucun to attack, he struck suddenly and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍克景德鎮，追至浮梁，爭渡橋，賊返鬥，城賊出助。

translations.literal: When allied armies captured Jingdezhen and pursued to Fuliang, they vied to cross the bridge; the rebels turned and fought back, and the garrison rebels came out to assist.
translations.idiomatic: When allied armies captured Jingdezhen and pursued to Fuliang, they vied to cross the bridge. The rebels turned and fought back, and the garrison rebels came out to assist.

sentences.zh: 松山據橋血戰，軍賴以全，遂克浮梁，擢副將。

translations.literal: Songshan held the bridge in bloody battle; the army owed its survival to this, and Fuliang was then captured; he was promoted to brigade deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan held the bridge in bloody battle, and the army owed its survival to him. Fuliang was then captured, and he was promoted to brigade deputy.

sentences.zh: 十年，追敘連州功，加總兵銜，賜號志勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, past merit at Lianzhou was assessed; he received the brevet rank of regional commander and was granted the title Zhiyong Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his past merit at Lianzhou was assessed. He received the brevet rank of regional commander and was granted the honorific title Zhiyong Batulu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，克建德、黟縣，進攻徽州，賊夜劫營，諸營皆潰，松山列隊月下不少動，賊不敢逼。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he captured Jiande and Yi County and advanced to attack Huizhou; rebels raided the camp by night and all camps broke; Songshan drew up ranks under the moon without shifting; the rebels did not dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he captured Jiande and Yi County and advanced to attack Huizhou. The rebels raided the camp by night and every camp broke except his. Liu Songshan drew up his ranks under the moon without shifting, and the rebels did not dare press close.

sentences.zh: 遮諸將曰：「我第四旗劉松山也！」

translations.literal: He blocked the generals' path and said: "I am Liu Songshan of the Fourth Banner!"
translations.idiomatic: He blocked the fleeing generals and cried: "I am Liu Songshan of the Fourth Banner!"

sentences.zh: 戒勿奔，眾始定。

translations.literal: Do not flee!" Only then did the men settle.
translations.idiomatic: "Do not flee!" Only then did the men settle.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓自是待之以國士。

translations.literal: From this time Zeng Guofan treated him as a man of national talent.
translations.idiomatic: From this time Zeng Guofan treated him as a man of national stature.

sentences.zh: 賊再入黟縣，再克之。

translations.literal: The rebels re-entered Yi County; he captured it again.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels re-entered Yi County, he captured it again.

sentences.zh: 毀樟嶺、盧村賊壘，賊棄徽州遁，進克休寧，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: He destroyed the rebel fortifications at Zhangling and Lucun; the rebels abandoned Huizhou and fled; he advanced and captured Xiuning and was registered for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He destroyed the rebel fortifications at Zhangling and Lucun. The rebels abandoned Huizhou and fled. He advanced and captured Xiuning and was registered for appointment as regional commander.

sentences.zh: 楊輔清复糾黨圍徽州，松山四戰皆捷。

translations.literal: Yang Fuqing again gathered followers to besiege Huizhou; Songshan won all four battles.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Fuqing again gathered followers to besiege Huizhou, Liu Songshan won all four battles.

sentences.zh: 援軍至，會擊於岩市，賊引去。

translations.literal: When relief troops arrived, they joined in an attack at Yanshi and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When relief troops arrived, they joined in an attack at Yanshi and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，克旌德。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Jingde.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he captured Jingde.

sentences.zh: 張運蘭以病歸，松山與總兵易開俊分領其眾。

translations.literal: Zhang Yunlan returned home on account of illness; Songshan and regional commander Yi Kaijun divided command of his troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Yunlan returned home on account of illness, Liu Songshan and regional commander Yi Kaijun divided command of his troops.

sentences.zh: 守寧國，大疫，士卒多病，松山加意撫循，力疾戰守。

translations.literal: Garrisoning Ningguo during a great epidemic, many soldiers fell ill; Songshan gave special care in comforting them and, though ill himself, battled and held firm.
translations.idiomatic: While garrisoning Ningguo during a great epidemic, many of his soldiers fell ill. Liu Songshan gave them special care and comfort, and though ill himself, he battled on and held the city.

sentences.zh: 二年，援涇縣，破賊於金村、李村，而賊乘虛襲寧國，松山馳還，設伏敬亭山，伺賊至，分三路鼓譟而進，伏起夾擊，伏尸塞途，蹙餘賊水濱多死。

translations.literal: In the second year he went to relieve Jing County and defeated rebels at Jincun and Licun, but the rebels seized the opportunity to strike Ningguo; Songshan raced back and set an ambush on Jingtingshan; when the rebels arrived he advanced along three routes with drum and clamor; the ambush rose to attack from both sides; corpses of the fallen filled the road; he drove the remaining rebels to the riverbank where many died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he went to relieve Jing County and defeated the rebels at Jincun and Licun, but the rebels seized the opportunity to strike Ningguo. Liu Songshan raced back and set an ambush on Jingtingshan. When the rebels arrived, he advanced along three routes with drums and clamor. The ambush rose to attack from both sides, corpses of the fallen filled the road, and he drove the survivors to the riverbank where many drowned.

sentences.zh: 三年，大軍克江寧，松山收降潰賊四千人。

translations.literal: In the third year the main army captured Jiangning; Songshan received the surrender of four thousand scattered rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the main army captured Jiangning, and Liu Songshan received the surrender of four thousand scattered rebels.

sentences.zh: 皖境肅清，署皖南鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When Anhui was pacified, he was appointed acting regional commander of Southern Anhui Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui was pacified, he was appointed acting regional commander of Southern Anhui Garrison.

sentences.zh: 四年，授甘肅肅州鎮總兵，仍調皖南鎮。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of Suzhou Garrison in Gansu but was still transferred to Southern Anhui Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed regional commander of Suzhou Garrison in Gansu but remained assigned to Southern Anhui Garrison.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓督師剿捻匪，奏以鬆山獨統湘軍從征，屯臨淮。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan directed the campaign against the Nian bandits and memorialized that Songshan alone should command the Hunan army on campaign; he encamped at Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng Guofan directed the campaign against the Nian bandits, he memorialized that Liu Songshan alone should command the Hunan army on campaign. Songshan encamped at Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 時湘將久役思歸，又不習北方水土，皆不原從。

translations.literal: At the time Hunan generals, long on campaign, longed to return home and were unaccustomed to the climate and terrain of the north; none wished to follow.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Hunan generals, weary from long service, longed to return home and were unaccustomed to the climate and terrain of the north. None wished to follow.

sentences.zh: 惟松山投袂而起，立率所部渡江。

translations.literal: Only Songshan flung up his sleeves and rose, immediately leading his troops across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Only Liu Songshan flung up his sleeves and rose at once, leading his troops across the river.

sentences.zh: 有譁餉者，誅數人而定。

translations.literal: When there were those who mutinied over pay, he executed several men and order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When some of his men mutinied over pay, he executed several ringleaders and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 五年，敗捻首張總愚、牛洛紅於湖團，又敗之於徐州西，追剿入河南。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he defeated the Nian chiefs Zhang Zongyu and Niu Luohong at Hutuan, defeated them again west of Xuzhou, and pursued the campaign into Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he defeated the Nian chiefs Zhang Zongyu and Niu Luohong at Hutuan, defeated them again west of Xuzhou, and pursued the campaign into Henan.

sentences.zh: 張總愚踞西華，牛洛紅踞上蔡，設伏萬金寨，圖鈔襲官軍。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyu held Xihua, Niu Luohong held Shangcai; they set an ambush at Wanjinzhai intending a surprise attack on the government army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu held Xihua and Niu Luohong held Shangcai. They set an ambush at Wanjinzhai, intending a surprise attack on the government army.

sentences.zh: 松山與總兵李祥和擊破之，進攻雙廟，大破之，又敗之郾城、南陽、新野。

translations.literal: Songshan and regional commander Li Xianghe broke them, advanced to attack Shuangmiao and routed them, and defeated them again at Yancheng, Nanyang, and Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan and regional commander Li Xianghe broke them, advanced to attack Shuangmiao and routed them, and defeated them again at Yancheng, Nanyang, and Xinye.

sentences.zh: 總愚挾眾竄陝西，自此與任柱等分，不復合，號為西捻。

translations.literal: Zongyu fled with his followers into Shaanxi; from this time he separated from Ren Zhu and the others and they no longer reunited, and were called the Western Nian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu fled with his followers into Shaanxi. From this time he separated from Ren Zhu and the others and they never reunited again. They were called the Western Nian.

sentences.zh: 時議遣援剿之師，因陝境殘破，諸將皆觀望。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of dispatching a relief army for the suppression campaign; because Shaanxi was ravaged and ruined, all the generals held back and watched.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was discussion of dispatching a relief army for the suppression campaign, but because Shaanxi was ravaged and ruined, all the generals held back and watched.

sentences.zh: 惟松山毅然自任，率師西行，曾國籓尤重之。

translations.literal: Only Songshan resolutely took the task upon himself, led his army west, and Zeng Guofan valued him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Only Liu Songshan resolutely took the task upon himself and led his army west. Zeng Guofan valued him all the more.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢廣東陸路提督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of Guangdong land forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to provincial military commander of the Guangdong land forces.

sentences.zh: 張總愚與回匪合，踞郿縣，進擊走之。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyu joined with Muslim rebels and held Mei County; Songshan advanced, attacked, and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu joined with Muslim rebels and held Mei County. Liu Songshan advanced, attacked, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 轉戰扶風、岐山間，於涇陽要擊竄賊，殲斃數千。

translations.literal: Fighting between Fufeng and Qishan, he intercepted fleeing rebels at Jingyang and killed several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting between Fufeng and Qishan, he intercepted the fleeing rebels at Jingyang and killed several thousand.

sentences.zh: 追至富平，破其壘，而陝軍戰灞橋失利，賊犯同州、朝邑。

translations.literal: He pursued to Fuping and broke their fortifications, but the Shaanxi army was defeated in battle at Baqiao; the rebels invaded Tongzhou and Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued to Fuping and broke their fortifications, but the Shaanxi army was defeated at Baqiao and the rebels invaded Tongzhou and Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 松山疾趨，及賊於晉成堡、姜彥村，張兩翼擊之，賊敗走。

translations.literal: Songshan hurried forward, caught the rebels at Jincheng Fort and Jiangyancun, spread both wings to attack, and the rebels were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan hurried forward, caught the rebels at Jincheng Fort and Jiangyancun, spread both wings to attack, and the rebels were defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 追至許家莊，復返鬥，血戰四時，大破之，同、朝圍解，被珍賚。

translations.literal: He pursued to Xujiazhuang; they turned and fought again; after four hours of bloody battle he routed them; the sieges of Tong and Chao were lifted; he received precious rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued to Xujiazhuang. The rebels turned and fought again, and after four hours of bloody battle he routed them. The sieges of Tongzhou and Chaoyi were lifted, and he received precious rewards from the throne.

sentences.zh: 賊勢猶張，渡渭犯西安，松山會戰於城南，斬馘數千，解散萬人。

translations.literal: Rebel strength was still rampant; they crossed the Wei and invaded Xi'an; Songshan joined battle south of the city, beheaded and counted several thousand kills, and disbanded ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel strength was still rampant. They crossed the Wei River and invaded Xi'an. Liu Songshan joined battle south of the city, killed and counted several thousand, and disbanded ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 六月，左宗棠蒞陝督師，張總愚复結回匪窺同州、朝邑，分黨踞流曲鎮、王寮鎮以阻師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Zuo Zongtang arrived in Shaanxi to direct the campaign; Zhang Zongyu again allied with Muslim rebels to spy on Tongzhou and Chaoyi, dividing his forces to hold Liuqu Town and Wangliao Town to block the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zuo Zongtang arrived in Shaanxi to direct the campaign. Zhang Zongyu again allied with Muslim rebels and eyed Tongzhou and Chaoyi, dividing his forces to hold Liuqu Town and Wangliao Town and block the army's advance.

sentences.zh: 松山連拔二鎮，繞北山趨朝邑，截賊前。

translations.literal: Songshan captured both towns in succession, circled through the northern hills toward Chaoyi, and cut off the rebels' advance.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan captured both towns in succession, circled through the northern hills toward Chaoyi, and cut off the rebels' advance.

sentences.zh: 賊走高陵，复渡涇而東，松山據涇，濬壕築牆而守。

translations.literal: The rebels fled toward Gaoling, again crossed the Jing River eastward; Songshan held the Jing, dug moats and built walls, and defended.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled toward Gaoling and again crossed the Jing River eastward. Liu Songshan held the Jing, dug moats, built walls, and defended.

sentences.zh: 賊鋌走入北山，陷綏德州。

translations.literal: The rebels dashed into the northern hills and captured Suide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels dashed into the northern hills and captured Suide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月，松山偕郭寶昌擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Songshan together with Guo Baochang defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Songshan together with Guo Baochang defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賊棄綏德城，踐冰渡河，入山西，陷吉州、鄉寧。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned Suide city, crossed the river on the ice, entered Shanxi, and captured Jizhou and Xiangning.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned Suide city, crossed the river on the ice, entered Shanxi, and captured Jizhou and Xiangning.

sentences.zh: 松山偕郭寶昌追剿，克二城，解河津、稷山之圍，又追敗之洪洞。

translations.literal: Songshan together with Guo Baochang pursued the suppression campaign, captured both cities, lifted the sieges of Hejin and Jishan, and pursued and defeated them again at Hongdong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan together with Guo Baochang pursued the campaign, captured both cities, lifted the sieges of Hejin and Jishan, and defeated the rebels again at Hongdong.

sentences.zh: 賊由垣曲入河南境，七年正月，迳犯畿輔。

translations.literal: The rebels entered Henan from Yuanqu; in the first month of the seventh year they directly invaded the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels entered Henan from Yuanqu, and in the first month of the seventh year they directly invaded the capital region.

sentences.zh: 松山間道逾太行，冒雪日行百數十里，先諸軍抵保定，特詔嘉獎，優敘。

translations.literal: Songshan took a bypath over the Taihang Mountains, marched a hundred-odd li through the snow each day, arrived at Baoding ahead of all other armies; special edict of commendation and preferential assessment of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan took a bypath over the Taihang Mountains, marching more than a hundred li through the snow each day, and arrived at Baoding ahead of all other armies. A special edict commended him and his merits were assessed with preferential honors.

sentences.zh: 敗賊於獻縣商家林，又敗之深州、博野。

translations.literal: He defeated the rebels at Shangjialin in Xian County and defeated them again at Shenzhou and Boye.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the rebels at Shangjialin in Xian County and defeated them again at Shenzhou and Boye.

sentences.zh: 偕郭寶昌、張曜、宋慶合擊於深澤，大破之，賊渡滹沱南竄。

translations.literal: Together with Guo Baochang, Zhang Yao, and Song Qing he launched a combined attack at Shenze, routed them, and the rebels crossed the Hutuo southward in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Guo Baochang, Zhang Yao, and Song Qing he launched a combined attack at Shenze and routed them. The rebels crossed the Hutuo southward in flight.

sentences.zh: 畿輔解嚴，晉號達桑阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Martial law in the capital region was lifted; he was advanced in honorific title to Dasang'a Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: Martial law in the capital region was lifted, and he was advanced in honorific title to Dasang'a Batulu.

sentences.zh: 迭追擊於河南延津、封丘，山東海豐，直隸長垣、慶雲、滄州、吳橋，大小數十戰，與淮、楚諸軍長圍困賊，六月，張總愚赴水死。

translations.literal: He pursued in succession at Yanjin and Fengqiu in Henan, Haifeng in Shandong, and Changyuan, Qingyun, Cangzhou, and Wuqiao in Zhili — several dozen battles large and small; with the Huai and Chu armies he maintained a long encirclement pressing the rebels; in the sixth month Zhang Zongyu drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the rebels in succession at Yanjin and Fengqiu in Henan, Haifeng in Shandong, and Changyuan, Qingyun, Cangzhou, and Wuqiao in Zhili — several dozen battles large and small. Together with the Huai and Chu armies he maintained a long encirclement of the rebels, and in the sixth month Zhang Zongyu drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 捻匪平，賜黃馬褂，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: When the Nian bandits were pacified, he was granted the yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of third-class commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: When the Nian bandits were pacified, he was granted the yellow riding jacket and given the hereditary office of third-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 從左宗棠還陝剿回。

translations.literal: He followed Zuo Zongtang back to Shaanxi to suppress the Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Zuo Zongtang back to Shaanxi to suppress the Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 松山在軍十餘年，僅因募勇一歸里，聘婦二十年未娶；

translations.literal: Songshan had been in the army more than ten years and had returned home only once to recruit troops; he had been betrothed for twenty years without marrying;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan had been in the army for more than ten years and had returned home only once to recruit troops. He had been betrothed for twenty years without marrying;

sentences.zh: 至是婦家待於洛陽，成禮旬日即行。

translations.literal: now the bride's family waited at Luoyang; he completed the ceremony and within ten days departed.
translations.idiomatic: Now the bride's family waited at Luoyang. He completed the wedding ceremony and within ten days departed.

sentences.zh: 冬，抵陝，議先平土匪，乃可專力剿回。

translations.literal: In winter he reached Shaanxi; they debated that local bandits must first be pacified before they could concentrate on suppressing the Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he reached Shaanxi. They agreed that local bandits must first be pacified before they could concentrate on suppressing the Muslim rebels.

sentences.zh: 次綏德，分軍攻懷遠大理川回巢。

translations.literal: At Suide he dispatched divided forces to attack the Muslim strongholds at Huaiyuan and Dalichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At Suide he dispatched divided forces to attack the Muslim strongholds at Huaiyuan and Dalichuan.

sentences.zh: 自督攻小理川、店子寺、周家嶮，悉拔之。

translations.literal: He personally directed attacks on Xiaolichuan, Dianzisi, and Zhoujiaxian, and captured them all.
translations.idiomatic: He personally directed attacks on Xiaolichuan, Dianzisi, and Zhoujiaxian and captured them all.

sentences.zh: 破定邊回酋馬萬得、馬棘子眾數万。

translations.literal: He defeated the Dingbian Muslim chiefs Ma Wande and Ma Jizi and their forces numbering tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the Dingbian Muslim chiefs Ma Wande and Ma Jizi and their forces, numbering tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 八年，部卒合會匪叛，踞綏德，松山馳捕首逆百餘人而定，自請重處，革職留任。

translations.literal: In the eighth year his troops joined with local secret-society bandits in revolt and seized Suide; Songshan raced there, captured more than a hundred ringleaders and restored order; he requested severe punishment for himself and was stripped of rank but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year his troops joined with local secret-society bandits in revolt and seized Suide. Liu Songshan raced there, captured more than a hundred ringleaders, and restored order. He requested severe punishment for himself and was stripped of rank but retained in office.

sentences.zh: 進剿西北路諸堡，收降董福祥等眾凡十七萬人，榆、延、綏、鄜四郡皆肅清。

translations.literal: He advanced to suppress the fortresses of the northwest route, received the surrender of Dong Fuxiang and others totaling one hundred seventy thousand men; the four prefectures of Yulin, Yan'an, Suide, and Fu were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to suppress the fortresses of the northwest route and received the surrender of Dong Fuxiang and others, totaling one hundred seventy thousand men. The four prefectures of Yulin, Yan'an, Suide, and Fu were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 秋，度隴規靈州，破李旺堡、黑城子回寨數百，克靈州，開復處分。

translations.literal: In autumn he crossed the Long Mountains toward Lingzhou, broke several hundred Muslim stockades at Liwang Fort and Heichengzi, captured Lingzhou, and was rewarded for restoring the territory.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he crossed the Long Mountains toward Lingzhou, broke several hundred Muslim stockades at Liwang Fort and Heichengzi, captured Lingzhou, and was rewarded for restoring the territory.

sentences.zh: 敗匪乞撫，察其詐，擊之，平大小堡寨數十。

translations.literal: Defeated rebels begged for peace; he detected their deception and attacked, pacifying several dozen large and small fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: When defeated rebels begged for peace, he detected their deception and attacked, pacifying several dozen large and small fortresses.

sentences.zh: 進攻金積堡。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Jinjibao.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to attack Jinjibao.

sentences.zh: 堡酋馬化隆悍狡為諸回之最，黨眾糧足，負嵎已久，官軍屢為所挫。

translations.literal: The fortress chieftain Ma Hualong was fierce and cunning beyond all other Muslims; his followers were numerous and well supplied with grain; entrenched for long with their backs to the cliffs, the government army had repeatedly been defeated by them.
translations.idiomatic: The fortress chieftain Ma Hualong was the fiercest and most cunning of all the Muslim leaders. His followers were numerous and well supplied with grain, and entrenched for long behind steep defenses. The government army had repeatedly been defeated by them.

sentences.zh: 松山先籌糧運，敗其黨援，大舉穩進。

translations.literal: Songshan first arranged grain transport, defeated their allied relief forces, and advanced in strength with steady pace.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan first arranged grain transport, defeated their allied relief forces, and advanced in strength with steady, deliberate pace.

sentences.zh: 西寧、河州、臨洮、靖遠諸回皆震其威，不敢來救，先平堡北諸莊寨。

translations.literal: Muslims of Xining, Hezhou, Lintao, Jingyuan and elsewhere were all awed by his might and dared not come to the rescue; he first pacified the villages and stockades north of the fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims of Xining, Hezhou, Lintao, Jingyuan, and elsewhere were all awed by his might and dared not come to the rescue. He first pacified the villages and stockades north of the fortress.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，賊在秦渠南，踞石家莊及馬五、馬七、馬八諸寨，負嵎抗拒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year the rebels south of the Qin Canal held Shijiazhuang and the stockades of Ma Wu, Ma Qi, and Ma Ba, stubbornly resisting with their backs to the cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year the rebels south of the Qin Canal held Shijiazhuang and the stockades of Ma Wu, Ma Qi, and Ma Ba, stubbornly resisting from entrenched positions.

sentences.zh: 松山先破石家莊，督攻馬五寨，破其援賊，毀外卡，縱火焚寨門。

translations.literal: Songshan first broke Shijiazhuang, directed the attack on Ma Wu's stockade, broke their relief force, destroyed the outer barriers, set fire and burned the stockade gate.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan first broke Shijiazhuang, directed the attack on Ma Wu's stockade, broke their relief force, destroyed the outer barriers, and set fire to the stockade gate.

sentences.zh: 垂克，砲中左乳，墜馬，諸將來視，叱令整隊速攻，毋亂行列，遂破馬五寨。

translations.literal: On the verge of capture, a cannonball struck his left breast; he fell from his horse; when generals came to see him he shouted that they should form ranks and attack swiftly without breaking formation; Ma Wu's stockade was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: On the verge of capture, a cannonball struck his left breast and he fell from his horse. When his generals came to see him, he shouted that they should form ranks and attack swiftly without breaking formation. Ma Wu's stockade was then taken.

sentences.zh: 松山創甚，顧諸將曰：「我受國恩未報，即死，毋遽歸我屍，當為厲鬼殺賊。」

translations.literal: Grievously wounded, Songshan looked at the generals and said: "I have not yet repaid the grace of the state; even if I die, do not hurry to return my corpse — I shall become a vengeful ghost to kill rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Grievously wounded, Liu Songshan looked at his generals and said: "I have not yet repaid the grace of the state. Even if I die, do not hurry to return my corpse — I shall become a vengeful ghost and kill rebels.

sentences.zh: 遂卒，年三十有八。

translations.literal: He then died, at the age of thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He then died, at the age of thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔嘉其謀勇兼優，無愧名將，贈太子少保，加騎都尉兼一云騎尉，入祀京師昭忠祠，立功地建專祠，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: When word reached the throne, an edict praised his combined excellence in strategy and courage, worthy of a famed general; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, additional captaincy of cavalry with one yunqiwei, enshrined in the Capital Shrine of Loyalty and Devotion, a dedicated shrine built at the place of his service, and given the posthumous name Zhongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, an edict praised his combined excellence in strategy and courage, declaring him worthy of a famed general. He was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, additional captaincy of cavalry with one yunqiwei, enshrined in the Capital Shrine of Loyalty and Devotion, and given a dedicated shrine at the place of his service. He was granted the posthumous name Zhongzhuang, Loyal and Valiant.

sentences.zh: 松山既歿，兄子錦棠代領其眾，留其柩未歸以系軍心。

translations.literal: After Songshan's death, his elder brother's son Jintang took command of his troops in his stead; his coffin was kept from being sent home to steady the army's morale.
translations.idiomatic: After Liu Songshan's death, his elder brother's son Liu Jintang took command of his troops in his stead. His coffin was kept from being sent home to steady the army's morale.

sentences.zh: 次年，克金積堡，特詔賜祭一壇。

translations.literal: The following year Jinjibao was captured; a special edict granted one ritual offering altar in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Jinjibao was captured, and a special edict granted one ritual offering altar in his honor.

sentences.zh: 十二年，甘回悉平，追論前功，加一等輕車都尉，並世職為二等子爵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when the Gansu Muslims were wholly pacified, past merits were assessed posthumously; he was granted an additional first-class commandant of light chariots, and his hereditary office was combined as a second-class viscount.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when the Gansu Muslims were wholly pacified, his past merits were assessed posthumously. He was granted an additional first-class commandant of light chariots, and his hereditary office was combined as a second-class viscount.

sentences.zh: 嗣子鼒襲，官至山西按察使。

translations.literal: His son Zi inherited the rank and rose to the office of provincial judicial commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zi inherited the hereditary rank and eventually rose to provincial judicial commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：曾國籓湘軍初起，賴塔齊佈為助，及規江寧，清江、皖後路，則鮑超之力為多。

translations.literal: The commentary says: When Zeng Guofan's Hunan army was first raised, it relied on Taqibu for help; when it turned to plan for Jiangning and to secure the rear routes through the Qing River region and Anhui, Bao Chao's strength counted for the most.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe that when Zeng Guofan's Hunan army was first formed, it depended heavily on Taqibu; when the campaign turned toward Jiangning and toward securing the rear through the Qing River region and Anhui, Bao Chao's contribution was greatest of all.

sentences.zh: 胡林翼由鄂規皖，悉倚多隆阿、鮑超二人。

translations.literal: When Hu Linyi planned for Anhui from Hubei, he relied entirely on Dolong'a and Bao Chao, the two of them.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu Linyi advanced on Anhui from Hubei, he relied entirely on Dolong'a and Bao Chao.

sentences.zh: 塔齊布不幸早歿。

translations.literal: Taqibu, unhappily, died young.
translations.idiomatic: Taqibu, alas, died before his time.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿才略冠時，朝廷倚以剿回，中道而殞，未竟其用。

translations.literal: Dolong'a's talent and strategy topped his age; the court relied on him to suppress the Muslims; he died midway and did not fulfill his use.
translations.idiomatic: Dolong'a's talent and strategy were unmatched in his day; the court relied on him to suppress the Muslim rebels, but he died in mid-career before his abilities could be fully realized.

sentences.zh: 鮑超攻戰無敵，動招眾忌，功成身退，亦以保全之。

translations.literal: Bao Chao was unmatched in attack and battle, yet constantly drew widespread envy; he achieved merit and withdrew from office, and thus preserved himself as well.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Chao was unrivaled in the field, yet he constantly provoked envy; by achieving his aims and then retiring, he also preserved himself.

sentences.zh: 劉松山後起，忠誠獨著，左宗棠平捻、平回，胥資其力；

translations.literal: Liu Songshan rose later, his loyalty standing alone in distinction; when Zuo Zongtang pacified the Nian and pacified the Muslims, he drew on his strength in both;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Songshan came to prominence later, distinguished above all for loyalty; Zuo Zongtang's pacification of the Nian and of the Muslim rebels both owed much to his strength;

sentences.zh: 使獲永年，其建樹未可量也。

translations.literal: had he been granted long life, his achievements would have been beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: had he lived out a full span of years, his achievements might have been beyond reckoning.
